release.title: Signing, TestFlight and App Store Connect
release.intro: Failures of the signed archive, export, validation, upload, processing and App Store Connect API calls. Rows marked "owner" are stops: send one message and never retry.

deps.title: Dependencies and supply chain
deps.intro: Failures while installing, pinning or upgrading packages, and packages that must never be installed.

lint.title: TypeScript and ESLint
lint.intro: Compiler and lint errors seen with the strict TypeScript 6 setup and the one ESLint 9 flat config, and the config bugs found while verifying them.

testing.title: Jest, RNTL, Maestro and Stryker
testing.intro: Failures of unit, component, golden, mutation and end-to-end tests.

engine.title: Game engine, Skia, Reanimated and gestures
engine.intro: Failures in boards, animation clocks, worklets, determinism, gestures and state updates.

i18n.title: Languages, RTL and fonts
i18n.intro: Failures with Intl on Hermes, message catalogs, right-to-left layout, digits and fonts.

services.title: Ads, purchases, audio and privacy
services.intro: Failures with AdMob and consent, StoreKit purchases, audio and haptics, privacy manifests and the network promise.

gates.intro: Failures of the gates themselves, lefthook, Claude Code hooks and commit rules.

skills.intro: Why a skill does not load, trigger or run, and other Claude Code behaviours that break an unattended session.

open.title: Open risks and owner decisions
open.intro: Known unknowns: behaviour not yet verified, and decisions only the owner can make. Each row says what to do until it is settled.

entries.symptom: xcodebuild -version prints Xcode 27.0, or a built app has DTXcode 2700
entries.cause: /Applications/Xcode.app is Xcode 27.0 on this Mac; a tool used it because DEVELOPER_DIR was not set, or someone ran xcode-select
entries.fix: Select Xcode 26.6 per process with DEVELOPER_DIR from selectXcode(); never run xcode-select

entries.symptom: Black screen at launch after building with Xcode 27 on Expo SDK 57
entries.cause: The iOS 27 SDK expects the UIScene life cycle; SDK 57 still uses the application life cycle
entries.fix: Add ['expo-build-properties', { ios: { enableSceneSupport: true } }] (expo 57.0.23+) before switching Xcode, or stay on Xcode 26.6

entries.symptom: You have not agreed to the Xcode license agreements
entries.cause: The selected Xcode was installed but its licence was never accepted
entries.fix: Owner step O4: sudo <Xcode>/Contents/Developer/usr/bin/xcodebuild -license accept (the agent never runs sudo)

entries.symptom: Error reading Expo config ... Cannot find module './game.config'
entries.cause: app.config.ts is loaded by Node type stripping, which needs explicit .ts extensions
entries.fix: Import './game.config.ts' and '@e07/shell/config/with-shell.ts'; tsconfig needs allowImportingTsExtensions and erasableSyntaxOnly

entries.symptom: SyntaxError: Unexpected token { while reading app.config.ts
entries.cause: Node runs without type stripping (NODE_OPTIONS=--no-strip-types, or Node older than 22.18)
entries.fix: Use Node 26.4.0 from mise (engines >=22.18); never set --no-strip-types

entries.symptom: Warning MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON when Node loads .ts files
entries.cause: A package's ESM .ts files load without "type": "module" in its package.json
entries.fix: Shell, game-kit and tooling declare "type": "module"; apps cannot while metro.config.js is CommonJS, so scripts importing app files pass --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON (harmless; verified alternative: "type": "module" in the app plus metro.config.cjs)

entries.symptom: EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_VARIANT=test must equal APP_VARIANT=store
entries.cause: Only one of the two variant variables was exported
entries.fix: Export APP_VARIANT, EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_VARIANT (same value) and ADS_MODE once for the whole run

entries.symptom: ADS_MODE=live is not allowed when APP_VARIANT=test (or store with test ads)
entries.cause: Real ads in a test build and test ads in a store build are forbidden pairs
entries.fix: Test builds use ADS_MODE off|test, store builds off|live
match: ADS_MODE=\w+ is not allowed when APP_VARIANT

entries.symptom: A store build still contains the debug module or shows variant=test (sentinel SHELL_TEST_BUILD_ONLY in main.jsbundle)
entries.cause: Metro inlines EXPO_PUBLIC_* at transform time but does not key its cache on them; the cache in $TMPDIR/metro-cache is shared by every project
entries.fix: config.cacheVersion = `app-variant-${process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_VARIANT ?? 'test'}` in every app's metro.config.js; prove with a back-to-back test and store build

entries.symptom: Test-only module still in the store bundle although gated by IS_TEST_BUILD
entries.cause: Metro strips a require only when the literal EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_VARIANT comparison is in the same expression; an imported constant does not fold
entries.fix: Reach test-only code only through packages/shell/src/app/test-only.ts with process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_VARIANT === 'store' ? null : require(...)

entries.symptom: EXConstants.bundle/app.config extra.adsMode or extra.appVariant differs from the requested variant
entries.cause: The variables were set for prebuild but not for xcodebuild, whose Constants and Metro phases evaluate the config again
entries.fix: Build one environment and pass it to every step (build-ios-sim.ts does)

entries.symptom: Setting EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_VARIANT inside app.config.ts has no effect on the bundle
entries.cause: Metro runs later, in the Xcode build phase, with its own environment
entries.fix: Export the variable in the build script for the whole run; resolveBuildVariant only checks it

entries.symptom: Crash at launch mentioning GADApplicationIdentifier
entries.cause: The AdMob plugin is missing or got no iosAppId, so Info.plist lacks the app ID the linked SDK requires
entries.fix: withShell always passes an app ID (the Google sample ID unless ADS_MODE=live); clean prebuild

entries.symptom: pod install fails downloading Google-Mobile-Ads-SDK, GoogleUserMessagingPlatform or openiap
entries.cause: The three trunk pods are downloaded at prebuild time; no network or a CDN problem
entries.fix: Retry once after 5 minutes; never loosen pod versions

entries.symptom: The prebuilt app has no PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy
entries.cause: Expo prebuild generates none unless the config declares ios.privacyManifests
entries.fix: withShell declares ios.privacyManifests (NSPrivacyTracking false plus the aggregated required-reason APIs)

entries.symptom: The app rotates to landscape on iPad although orientation is portrait
entries.cause: With supportsTablet, prebuild writes all four iPad orientations; iOS 27-SDK builds also make iPhone apps resizable
entries.fix: Never assume the screen size: lay out from useWindowDimensions and safe-area insets; screenshot iPad landscape

entries.symptom: Prebuild warns: Install expo-system-ui in your project to enable this feature
entries.cause: Android-only: userInterfaceStyle 'automatic' needs expo-system-ui
entries.fix: Ignore on iOS; add expo-system-ui when Android starts (knip then needs it listed)

entries.symptom: xcodebuild cannot find the workspace or scheme named after package.json
entries.cause: The workspace and scheme come from expo.name with spaces removed (Line Siege -> LineSiege)
entries.fix: Discover ios/*.xcworkspace after prebuild and derive the scheme from it

entries.symptom: Signing for "<App>" requires a development team on a simulator build
entries.cause: CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO is missing from the simulator build
entries.fix: Simulator builds never sign: Release, -sdk iphonesimulator, ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=YES ARCHS=arm64 CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO

entries.symptom: simctl io <udid> screenshot /dev/null fails: Operation not permitted
entries.cause: simctl cannot write its PNG to /dev/null
entries.fix: Write to a temporary file and delete it

entries.symptom: A screenshot right after simctl bootstatus -b is black with a small spinner
entries.cause: bootstatus returns while SpringBoard is still starting
entries.fix: Wait for the app ready signal (perf log or two identical screenshots after 3 s) before the screenshot that counts

entries.symptom: A "Ready for Apple Intelligence" banner covers the app on a new simulator
entries.cause: One-time system banner on the first launch after simctl create
entries.fix: Warm a new simulator up once and discard its first capture

entries.symptom: Status bar shows 09:41 (or a charging bolt) after simctl status_bar override --time 9:41
entries.cause: The simulator inherited the Mac's 24-hour region; --batteryState charged draws a bolt
entries.fix: simctl spawn <udid> defaults write -g AppleLocale -string en_US, reboot, re-apply; use --batteryState discharging --batteryLevel 100; overrides reset on every reboot

entries.symptom: simctl status_bar rejects --time "9:41 AM" or 2026-09-27T09:41:00Z (Invalid, non-ISO date/time string)
entries.cause: Only 9:41 style or an ISO date with milliseconds is accepted

entries.symptom: "Open in <App>?" alert after simctl openurl; testIDs vanish from maestro hierarchy
entries.cause: iOS asks before opening a custom scheme (iOS 26.5 always asks after simctl openurl and nothing accepts the prompt); pending alerts queue and dim the app
entries.fix: Never send a debug link with simctl openurl: open it through Maestro's debug-setup.yaml sub-flow (run-e2e-ios's cold-start setup does this through debugSetupArgs, and build-ios-sim's --link uses the same sub-flow); check-e2e-setup's openurl-prompt rule catches a runner that still calls simctl openurl; on a fresh simulator iOS asks once per app, and a tap while the alert is still sliding in is lost, so the sub-flow waits for the animation to end before it taps Open and taps once more if the alert is still there

entries.symptom: A launch argument such as -AppleLanguages "(fa)" stored in a variable is ignored
entries.cause: zsh does not word-split $ARGS, so the words arrive as one argument
entries.fix: Pass each word separately or use a bash array

entries.symptom: simctl create "iPhone 16 Pro" on iOS 26.5 is not in the default device list
entries.cause: The iOS 26.5 runtime ships the iPhone 17 family and iPad (M5) models; iPhone 16 exists on iOS 18 runtimes
entries.fix: Use iPhone 17 Pro Max / iPhone 17 Pro on iOS 26.5 (create by name; creating an iPhone 16 Pro on 26.5 also works when a profile needs it)

entries.symptom: Another task's simulator was shut down or erased
entries.cause: simctl shutdown all / erase all touch every simulator on the Mac
entries.fix: Name simulators e07-<purpose>, target them by UDID, delete only your own

entries.symptom: Screenshot is one flat light grey (#F2F2F2)
entries.cause: React Navigation's default screen background with no content: the screen component rendered nothing (a stub or null)
entries.fix: Build the screen; check-screenshot.mjs flags it as blank-screen

entries.symptom: Release app terminates: Unhandled JS Exception ... AppRegistryBinding::startSurface failed. Global was not installed
entries.cause: reloadAppAsync() was called during bundle evaluation, before the runtime was ready
entries.fix: Run the direction check and reload from the mounted splash screen's effect

entries.symptom: The Expo SDK 57 template ships .claude/settings.json enabling expo@claude-plugins-official, and AGENTS.md says npx expo lint
entries.cause: Template defaults: the plugin adds a remote MCP server and EAS skills that pull toward cloud services the spec forbids
entries.fix: Merge the project settings into that file (never overwrite it); rewrite AGENTS.md to name the npm scripts; the owner decides whether the plugin stays (if kept, forbid EAS Update, Observe and Hosting)

entries.symptom: The create-expo-app template brings Expo Router and src/app routes
entries.cause: The project uses React Navigation 7 static API; in SDK 56+ Expo Router no longer supports importing @react-navigation/* in app code
entries.fix: Remove Expo Router from the template; one native stack in the Shell

entries.symptom: errSecInternalComponent from codesign during archive
entries.cause: The login keychain is locked (SSH or non-GUI session)
entries.fix: Stop (O8): the owner unlocks it (security unlock-keychain ~/Library/Keychains/login.keychain-db) or starts the run from the desktop; never retry; after the owner confirms, rerun with --resume build

entries.symptom: A macOS dialog "codesign wants to access key ..."
entries.cause: The key's access list does not include codesign yet
entries.fix: Stop: the owner clicks Always Allow once

entries.symptom: Text containing agreement (altool, App Store Connect) or PLA Update available (xcodebuild)
entries.cause: A new or expired Apple agreement
entries.fix: Stop (R4): the owner accepts it; then rerun with --resume build (same build number) if the stop came before the upload, otherwise a plain rerun

entries.symptom: print-app-record.ts exits 2, or the upload cannot determine the Apple ID for the bundle ID
entries.cause: The App Store Connect app record does not exist, and the public API cannot create apps
entries.fix: Stop (G2): the owner creates it (My Apps > + > New App), then rerun
match: No App Store Connect app record

entries.symptom: NOT_AUTHORIZED (401) from altool or the REST API
entries.cause: Wrong key or issuer ID, a revoked key, or clock skew (iat in the future)
entries.fix: Stop (O3): check the env IDs against the key file name without reading it and that the Mac clock is on network time; a revoked key needs a new team key

entries.symptom: FORBIDDEN_ERROR (403), or "not allowed to create distribution certificates"
entries.cause: The key role is below Admin, or it is an individual key
entries.fix: Stop (O3): the owner creates a team key with the Admin role

entries.symptom: Build processing state INVALID or FAILED
entries.cause: Apple rejected the binary during processing
entries.fix: Stop: ask the owner to forward Apple's email; fix, then rebuild with a new build number

entries.symptom: ITMS-90189: Redundant Binary Upload
entries.cause: The build number was reused
entries.fix: Never reuse or roll back: bump and rebuild (check the earlier upload's processing first)

entries.symptom: ITMS-90062: version must be higher than the previously approved version
entries.cause: version was not raised after an approval
entries.fix: Raise version in game.config.ts and rebuild

entries.symptom: ITMS-90683: Missing purpose string in Info.plist (NSMicrophoneUsageDescription)
entries.cause: react-native-audio-api references record-permission APIs
entries.fix: Add a neutral NSMicrophoneUsageDescription through the audio plugin option iosMicrophonePermission, translated through expo.locales; rebuild with a new build number

entries.symptom: ITMS-91053 (missing API declaration), ITMS-91061 (missing privacy manifest for an SDK) or ITMS-91056 (invalid manifest)
entries.cause: The aggregated required-reason APIs are incomplete; Apple does not reliably read static-pod manifests
entries.fix: npm run audit:privacy, add the category and reason to ios.privacyManifests, prebuild, rebuild with a new build number; ask the owner for Apple's email

entries.symptom: No profiles for '<bundle id>' were found / Automatic signing is disabled
entries.cause: -allowProvisioningUpdates or the three -authenticationKey* flags are missing, or DEVELOPMENT_TEAM is empty
entries.fix: Pass the auth flags; export APPLE_TEAM_ID before prebuild (withShell writes it to ios.appleTeamId)

entries.symptom: altool --upload-package --wait returned but the build is not in TestFlight
entries.cause: --wait returns once the build is PROCESSING, not VALID
entries.fix: Poll processing (REST processingState) every 60 s for up to 60 minutes; done only at VALID

entries.symptom: Exported build has other version or build numbers than game.config.ts
entries.cause: manageAppVersionAndBuildNumber defaults to YES in ExportOptions
entries.fix: Set manageAppVersionAndBuildNumber false (both export-options files)

entries.symptom: xcodebuild warns that method app-store is deprecated
entries.cause: The ExportOptions method was renamed
entries.fix: Use method app-store-connect, destination export, signingStyle automatic

entries.symptom: grep finds 3940256099942544 in every store main.jsbundle
entries.cause: react-native-google-mobile-ads ships its TestIds module (18 occurrences) in every bundle
entries.fix: Check the sample publisher ID on the source-mapped expo export excluding node_modules; the binary gate checks GADApplicationIdentifier and the sentinel instead

entries.symptom: App Store Connect rejects a token that looks valid
entries.cause: Tokens that expire more than 20 minutes after iat are invalid; a stale clock also breaks iat
entries.fix: createAscJwt uses 15 minutes and a fresh token per request in long waits

entries.symptom: A JWT, Authorization header or key text appears in a log, report or commit
entries.cause: Debug output or a copy of the key
entries.fix: Stop and ask the owner to revoke the key, create a new team key, replace the file and update the IDs; check git log -p -S for the key header and reports/

entries.symptom: npm install fails with ETARGET for a pinned version
entries.cause: min-release-age=7 refuses versions younger than 7 days; the chosen stack was younger than that on 2026-09-26
entries.fix: A dated min-release-age-exclude block (expires 2026-10-03, enforced by check-deps.ts); after that date delete it, never extend it

entries.symptom: npx expo install writes ~57.0.3 (or ^17.2.0) despite save-exact=true
entries.cause: expo install writes the SDK range; third-party packages get a caret
entries.fix: Keep Expo-managed ranges as expo install writes them; change caret pins of other packages (AdMob, expo-iap, audio-api) to exact versions

entries.symptom: npm approve-scripts --allow-scripts-pending exits 0 even with unreviewed scripts
entries.cause: The command reports but never fails
entries.fix: Fail unless its output says "No packages with unreviewed install scripts."

entries.symptom: ESLint 10: contextOrFilename.getFilename is not a function (eslint-plugin-react)
entries.cause: eslint-config-expo 57 pulls eslint-plugin-react 7.37.x and eslint-plugin-import 2.32 whose peers stop at ESLint 9
entries.fix: Pin eslint 9.39.5; move only when eslint-config-expo ships an ESLint-10-ready eslint-plugin-react (PR #4022)

entries.symptom: TypeScript 7 installed: typescript-eslint and tools break
entries.cause: TS 7.0 ships no API; typescript-eslint peers typescript <6.1.0; Expo pins ~6.0.3
entries.fix: Stay on TypeScript ~6.0.3 until typescript-eslint supports TS 7 and Expo lists it

entries.symptom: Component tests fail oddly, or check-test-setup reports test-dep-missing or test-renderer-line, after installing @testing-library/react-native alone
entries.cause: npm's automatic peer install picks test-renderer 1.3.0, which targets React 19.3 and SDK 58; SDK 57 is React 19.2. RNTL 14.0.1's companion is test-renderer 1.2.0
entries.fix: Install both in one command: npm install --save-dev --save-exact @testing-library/react-native@14.0.1 test-renderer@1.2.0 (unit-and-component-tests' package.test-deps.json; plan-dependency prints the companion pin); npm ls test-renderer shows 1.2.0

entries.symptom: Jest 30 breaks the jest-expo preset
entries.cause: jest-expo 57 depends on Jest 29 packages; SDK 57 and 58 pin jest ~29.7.0
entries.fix: Stay on Jest 29.7 until jest-expo for the SDK depends on Jest 30

entries.symptom: npm offers react-native-gesture-handler 2.33.0 (legacy tag)
entries.cause: It is outside Expo SDK 57's ~2.32.0 range
entries.fix: Stay on 2.32.x through npx expo install

entries.symptom: npm latest react / react-native differ from the SDK pins (react 19.3, react-native 0.87)
entries.cause: Only the Expo SDK decides React and React Native versions
entries.fix: Never install either by hand; npx expo install --fix

entries.symptom: Skia 2.6.2 install needs an approved postinstall script
entries.cause: Skia had a postinstall until 2.6.5 (SDK 58 pins 2.11.2 without it)
entries.fix: Approve it on SDK 57 after reading it; drop the approval after the SDK 58 upgrade

entries.symptom: npm flags lefthook's postinstall as an unreviewed install script
entries.cause: npm's allowScripts is advisory now and will block later
entries.fix: Use "prepare": "lefthook install" so installation is explicit

entries.symptom: react-native-audio-api behaves differently after a minor bump, or npx expo install picks no version
entries.cause: It is pre-1.0 (0.x minors break) and not in Expo's bundledNativeModules
entries.fix: Pin the exact version (0.13.6), read release notes on every bump, override its plugin defaults (iosBackgroundMode false, no Android foreground service, disableFFmpeg, disableStaticExternalLibs)

entries.symptom: @react-native-community/netinfo makes an HTTP request to clients3.google.com from our bundle
entries.cause: Its default reachability config fetches generate_204 whenever the native layer gives no boolean
entries.fix: Ban NetInfo; online detection is expo-network (NWPathMonitor, no HTTP) behind ConnectivityPort

entries.symptom: A dependency adds a server, telemetry or OTA updates (expo-updates, expo-dev-client, expo-insights, expo-observe, @sentry/*, @react-native-firebase/*, react-native-purchases, react-native-webview)
entries.cause: Each is one install away and breaks the no-network promise
entries.fix: Keep them banned (check-deps and audit:network fail on them); updates.enabled false

entries.symptom: expo-iap config adds OnsideKit or IAPKit servers
entries.cause: The plugin options modules.onside / ios.onside.enabled and iapkitApiKey pull network code
entries.fix: Use a bare expo-iap plugin entry; never kitApi or verifyPurchaseWithProvider

entries.symptom: expo-audio installed for sound effects
entries.cause: Its plugin defaults enable Android recording and background playback, and its iOS player is AVPlayer-based (latency)
entries.fix: Use react-native-audio-api with synthesized buffers; do not install expo-audio

entries.symptom: knip reports "expo-updates unlisted"
entries.cause: knip's Expo plugin expects expo-updates unless updates.enabled is false
entries.fix: Set expo.updates.enabled = false (withShell does)

entries.symptom: knip reports babel-jest or @stryker-mutator/core as unlisted
entries.cause: jest.sim.config.js and Stryker use them from the root
entries.fix: List them as root devDependencies; handle app-installed native libraries used by jest.setup.ts with ignoreDependencies

entries.symptom: A just-published package (hours or days old) breaks after install
entries.cause: expo-iap 5.8.0, openiap-apple 3.6.0 and AdMob 17.2.0 were hours to a day old when chosen
entries.fix: Respect the 7-day release age; pin exactly; gate risky ones on their test tiers; keep a rollback version noted (AdMob 16.5.0, expo-iap 5.6.3)

entries.symptom: TS2593: Cannot find name 'describe'
entries.cause: TypeScript 6 defaults types to [], so Jest globals are unknown
entries.fix: Give test programs types: ["jest"] (tooling: ["node", "jest"])

entries.symptom: TS2591: Cannot find name 'process' (or 'node:fs') in the Shell or in scripts
entries.cause: The program has no Node types
entries.fix: Shell: declare const process in app-env.d.ts; Node scripts: a tsconfig with types node (never add Node types to app code)

entries.symptom: TS4111 on process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_VARIANT or process.argv
entries.cause: noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature requires bracket access unless the property is declared
entries.fix: Declare EXPO_PUBLIC_* in NodeJS.ProcessEnv (Expo inlines only dot access); bracket access in Node code

entries.symptom: TS1294: enum or constructor parameter property rejected
entries.cause: erasableSyntaxOnly (needed for Node type stripping) forbids non-erasable syntax
entries.fix: Use string-literal unions and 'as const' objects; plain constructor fields

entries.symptom: exactOptionalPropertyTypes rejects an explicit undefined prop (for example asChild)
entries.cause: Some third-party prop types do not include undefined
entries.fix: Conditional spread {...(x ? { asChild: true } : {})}; relax the flag only in the app workspace if unavoidable

entries.symptom: TS2559 on TextStyle after adding expo-env.d.ts to an app program
entries.cause: expo-env.d.ts pulls types that clash with the strict setup
entries.fix: Do not include expo-env.d.ts; app-env.d.ts declares what is needed

entries.symptom: A type-only import from an app file into with-shell.ts breaks tsc (process, node:fs unknown)
entries.cause: with-shell.ts is Node-world code; importing an app file drags the app program in
entries.fix: Keep GameConfig in the neutral @e07/shell/config/game-config.ts

entries.symptom: Assertion-free tests, duplicate titles and conditional expects pass lint
entries.cause: The test block spread flat/recommended and flat/style into one object; the second rules key replaced the first
entries.fix: Use extends: [jestPlugin.configs['flat/recommended'], jestPlugin.configs['flat/style']]; the guardrail asserts jest/expect-expect is active

entries.symptom: `fireEvent.press` is sync and does not need `await`
entries.cause: testing-library's no-await-sync-events contradicts RNTL 14, where fireEvent returns a Promise
entries.fix: Turn testing-library/no-await-sync-events off; keep await-async-events and no-floating-promises
match: is sync and does not need `?await

entries.symptom: The physical-direction ban fires on { left, right } keys in pure game rules
entries.cause: The selector matched any object key, but boards and game data are exempt from RTL rules
entries.fix: Scope the selector to style contexts (StyleSheet.create, style props, *Style-typed variables)

entries.symptom: An exhaustive 11-case switch fails 'complexity of 12. Maximum allowed is 10'
entries.cause: ESLint 9 counts every case, ?., ??, default parameter and logical assignment
entries.fix: complexity: ['error', { max: 10, variant: 'modified' }] (a switch counts once); sonarjs cognitive complexity still bounds nesting

entries.symptom: new Date() or performance.now() pass lint in game logic
entries.cause: Only Date.now and Math.random were banned
entries.fix: Add NewExpression[callee.name='Date'][arguments.length=0] and performance.now to the bans

entries.symptom: <Image source={{ uri: "https://..." }} /> passes lint
entries.cause: Layer A banned fetch but not URL literals, yet a remote image makes a request
entries.fix: Ban Literal and TemplateElement values starting with http(s)://, ws(s)://, ftp://; allow only external-links.ts

entries.symptom: IS_DEBUG_BUILD rejected: must have one of the following prefixes
entries.cause: The boolean prefix rule allowed only camelCase prefixes
entries.fix: Allow UPPER_CASE with IS_/HAS_/CAN_/SHOULD_/DID_/WILL_/WAS_ prefixes
match: must have one of the following prefixes

entries.symptom: const { granted } = ... or ({ disabled }: Props) rejected by naming-convention
entries.cause: Destructured booleans need the is/has prefix too
entries.fix: Rename while destructuring: { granted: isGranted }

entries.symptom: const RootStack = createNativeStackNavigator(...) rejected
entries.cause: A navigator object is a value, so camelCase
entries.fix: rootStack plus StaticParamList<typeof rootStack> and a ReactNavigation.RootParamList merge in a .d.ts

entries.symptom: check-file/filename-blocklist crashes with "invalid pattern"
entries.cause: The suggestion was free text
entries.fix: Give the rule a glob suggestion such as '**/[a-z]*-[a-z]*.ts'

entries.symptom: ({ pressed }) in a style callback fails naming; void promise.then(...) fails no-floating-promises
entries.cause: Boolean parameter naming and ignoreVoid: false
entries.fix: Rename ({ pressed: isPressed }); await or handle promises through the async-handler helper

entries.symptom: no-unused-styles reports every key as unused ("undefined.base")
entries.cause: makeStyles returned StyleSheet.create(...) directly
entries.fix: Use the block body: const styles = StyleSheet.create(...); return styles;

entries.symptom: props.items.push() is not flagged by the compiler rules
entries.cause: The React Compiler lint does not see array mutation through props
entries.fix: Type props readonly (readonly T[])

entries.symptom: exhaustive-deps, incompatible-library or unsupported-syntax only warn
entries.cause: eslint-plugin-react-hooks recommended marks them warn
entries.fix: Run eslint --max-warnings 0 and raise them to error

entries.symptom: An // eslint-disable comment has no effect and is reported
entries.cause: linterOptions.noInlineConfig and reportUnusedDisableDirectives
entries.fix: Fix the code, or add a named file-level exemption in eslint.config.mjs with the owner's agreement
match: has no effect because you have 'noInlineConfig'

entries.symptom: A later config block silently drops restricted paths of an earlier block
entries.cause: In flat config a later block replaces (not merges) the options of the same rule
entries.fix: Repeat the shared paths (build blocks from shared constants such as RUNTIME_PATHS)

entries.symptom: import/order wants a blank line between value and type imports of the same module
entries.cause: 'type' is its own group with newlines-between always
entries.fix: Put import type statements in a final group after a blank line
match: There should be at least one empty line between import groups

entries.symptom: @typescript-eslint/unbound-method flags expect(sdk.method) in tests; jest/unbound-method crashes under disableTypeChecked
entries.cause: Library-typed methods look unbound
entries.fix: Type the requireMock result locally or use jest/unbound-method; exclude **/*.test.ts from disableTypeChecked blocks

entries.symptom: naming-convention errors in __mocks__/react-native-google-mobile-ads.ts
entries.cause: The mock mirrors the library's PascalCase exports (AdsConsent, TestIds)
entries.fix: Turn naming-convention off for __mocks__/**

entries.symptom: Node scripts fail tsc with TS2591 (node:fs) and TS4111 (process.argv)
entries.cause: types: ['jest'] leaves out Node types for scripts inside the app program
entries.fix: Keep Node scripts in packages/tooling with types ["node", "jest"]; never inside an app program

entries.symptom: npm run lint grows slow with many apps
entries.cause: Type-aware lint builds one program per workspace
entries.fix: Lint per workspace in parallel past about 2 minutes; never weaken rules

entries.symptom: Metro or tsc cannot resolve @e07/shell/<path> without an extension
entries.cause: Workspace packages are consumed as TypeScript source with explicit extensions
entries.fix: Import @e07/shell/ui/app-text.tsx and ./x.ts with extensions; packages/shell exports './*': './src/*' and './plugins/*'

entries.symptom: react-native/Libraries/* imports become type errors on RN 0.87 / SDK 58
entries.cause: RN 0.87 makes the Strict TypeScript API the default
entries.fix: Never deep-import; opt into customConditions ['react-native-strict-api', 'react-native'] now

entries.symptom: Node scripts cannot import '@/...' aliases
entries.cause: Node type stripping ignores tsconfig paths
entries.fix: Use package self-references @e07/<package>/<path>.ts (exports map)

entries.symptom: Every Jest suite fails with a Flow syntax error in @react-native/jest-preset/jest/setup.js
entries.cause: babel.config.js is missing, so jest-expo cannot transform React Native
entries.fix: Create babel.config.js (npx expo customize babel.config.js; presets: babel-preset-expo)

entries.symptom: SyntaxError: Cannot use import statement outside a module in react-intl / @formatjs / intl-messageformat
entries.cause: All FormatJS packages are ESM-only
entries.fix: Allowlist them in transformIgnorePatterns
match: Cannot use import statement outside a module

entries.symptom: TurboModuleRegistry.getEnforcing(...): 'RNGoogleMobileAdsModule' could not be found
entries.cause: A test imported the real AdMob library
entries.fix: Root manual mock __mocks__/react-native-google-mobile-ads.ts (applied without jest.mock); Shell tests use fake ports

entries.symptom: Native Skia Module failed to correctly install JSI Bindings!
entries.cause: Skia was imported in the unit project (jest-expo environment)
entries.fix: Test board geometry as pure functions; pixel tests go in the golden project (testEnvironment @shopify/react-native-skia/jestEnv.js)

entries.symptom: After setting Skia's jestEnv globally, React Native tests misbehave and every file loads CanvasKit
entries.cause: Skia's jestEnv extends plain jest-environment-node and replaces RN's environment for every test
entries.fix: Jest projects: unit (jest-expo) and golden (*.golden.test.ts with the Skia env)

entries.symptom: New snapshot was not written. The update flag must be explicitly passed
entries.cause: jest --ci (default when CI=1) never writes snapshots
entries.fix: Create or update goldens deliberately with jest -u and a Gate-Change trailer

entries.symptom: Jest: Coverage data for ./packages/... was not found (exit 1)
entries.cause: A coverageThreshold key names a folder with no files yet
entries.fix: Add threshold keys only when fs.globSync finds source files (jest.config.js does)
match: Coverage data for .+ was not found

entries.symptom: act() warnings or empty screens in RNTL 14 tests
entries.cause: RNTL 14 render, fireEvent and user events are async
entries.fix: await render(), await user.press(), await fireEvent.press()

entries.symptom: expect(screen).toHavePathname throws 'screen.getPathname is not a function'
entries.cause: expo-router testing-library was written for RNTL 13
entries.fix: Not used here (React Navigation); if ever needed, use the view returned by renderRouter

entries.symptom: getByRole cannot find a View with a role
entries.cause: A plain View is found by role only when accessible
entries.fix: Set accessible on the View (Pressable is accessible by default)

entries.symptom: Cannot find module react-native-reanimated/jest/resolver
entries.cause: That path exists only in newer Reanimated docs, not in 4.5.1
entries.fix: jest.setup: RNGH jestSetup, jest.mock('react-native-worklets', () => require('react-native-worklets/src/mock')), require('react-native-reanimated').setUpTests()

entries.symptom: AudioManager.setAudioSessionOptions is not a function in tests
entries.cause: react-native-audio-api 0.13.6's own mock lacks setAudioSessionOptions and observeAudioInterruptions
entries.fix: Extend it in the root mock; re-check on every bump

entries.symptom: Stryker's initial run fails on a file-level 'worklet' module
entries.cause: Stryker injects helper functions that the Worklets plugin then workletizes
entries.fix: Compile Stryker workers without the Worklets/Reanimated plugins (babel.config.js branch); worklet-transform.test.ts covers the transform

entries.symptom: Stryker reports NoCoverage or false survivors for workspace modules
entries.cause: Its sandbox imported the original files through node_modules symlinks
entries.fix: Map @e07/* to <rootDir> paths with moduleNameMapper

entries.symptom: Mutants survive in an RNG covered only by properties
entries.cause: Determinism and range properties do not pin exact outputs
entries.fix: Add golden example values next to every property test

entries.symptom: A pixel golden passes although a two-digit label is missing
entries.cause: 0.1% tolerance: 77 of 218,400 pixels (0.035%) on a 390x560 board
entries.fix: Add recording-canvas assertions for every label, or a pixel-count threshold for text goldens

entries.symptom: A test using node:sqlite, Buffer or node:fs fails tsc inside packages/shell
entries.cause: Package programs carry only jest types
entries.fix: Put Node-API tests and drivers under the root test/integration/<area>/

entries.symptom: performance.now() timings in Jest are coarse
entries.cause: The jest preset's performance.now mock has 1 ms resolution
entries.fix: Measure fast code over many iterations; real timings come from device runs

entries.symptom: I18nManager.isRTL is false in every Jest test
entries.cause: @react-native/jest-preset mocks it
entries.fix: Test RTL through an explicit DirectionProvider direction="rtl"; layout itself is checked on the simulator

entries.symptom: setAirplaneMode does nothing on the iOS simulator
entries.cause: iOS simulators have no airplane mode (Android-only command)
entries.fix: Use the test build's Simulate offline debug switch

entries.symptom: maestro hierarchy misses testIDs
entries.cause: It lists only on-screen elements, hides children of accessible elements, and rounds bounds to whole points (about 11-19 s per call)
entries.fix: Put testIDs on the accessible element (the Pressable), scroll to the element first, allow ±1 pt

entries.symptom: A flow uses assertWithAI, assertNoDefectsWithAI or extractTextWithAI
entries.cause: They upload screenshots to an LLM service
entries.fix: Ban them in e2e/** (guardrail grep)

entries.symptom: maestro test --tags is rejected
entries.cause: Maestro 2.10 has --include-tags and --exclude-tags, no --tags
entries.fix: Use --include-tags / --exclude-tags

entries.symptom: Flows in sub-folders do not run
entries.cause: Maestro does not recurse into sub-folders
entries.fix: List the <area>/<nn>-<name>.yaml files explicitly (run-e2e-ios.ts does)

entries.symptom: maestro fails to start: no Java 17
entries.cause: Maestro needs Java 17; this Mac has it only as Android Studio's JBR
entries.fix: JAVA_HOME=/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home (or /usr/libexec/java_home -v 17)
match: Unable to locate a Java Runtime

entries.symptom: Pure-logic tests take 6-7 s cold per file
entries.cause: The jest-expo environment is loaded even for pure rules
entries.fix: Kept as decided (one unit project); revisit with a Node-environment logic project if npm test passes about 60 s

entries.symptom: The first move animates; every later move freezes, then jumps to the end
entries.cause: Reanimated resets timeSinceFirstFrame to 0 whenever a frame callback is re-activated
entries.fix: On a move JS writes startAt = -1; the frame callback sets startAt = f.timestamp on its first frame and uses f.timestamp - startAt; push view, tracks and startAt as one scene value

entries.symptom: A replay or bot run recorded in Jest diverges on the device (or iOS vs Android)
entries.cause: Hermes computes Math.sin, cos, exp, atan2 and pow with the platform C library; V8 uses its own
entries.fix: Rules, sims, geom and daily generation use only + - * /, Math.sqrt, imul, floor, round, abs, min, max; integer PRNG (sfc32); lint bans the rest there

entries.symptom: A crash on the UI thread when a gesture or frame callback calls a helper
entries.cause: A function without the 'worklet' directive cannot run on the UI thread (runtime, not build-time error)
entries.fix: Use the file-level 'worklet'; directive for sim, geom, layout and render modules; test that UI-thread modules import only worklet modules

entries.symptom: Persian or Sorani words on a board render as broken, unjoined letters
entries.cause: canvas.drawText does no shaping
entries.fix: Use Skia Paragraph (ParagraphBuilder with TextDirection.RTL) for Arabic-script words; drawText only for digits and Latin

entries.symptom: Frame drops when a board shows text
entries.cause: Building a Paragraph every frame is costly
entries.fix: Build on text or locale change and cache; use a retained <Paragraph> node (capture inside a Picture worklet is unverified)

entries.symptom: Canvas onLayout does not fire on the New Architecture
entries.cause: Canvas onLayout is deprecated on Fabric
entries.fix: Use onSize or useCanvasSize()

entries.symptom: Changing Reduce Motion while the app runs has no effect
entries.cause: Reanimated's useReducedMotion is a constant captured at module load
entries.fix: Read reduce motion through the Shell setting and ReducedMotionConfig; restart needed for the system value

entries.symptom: Shared value updates misbehave under the React Compiler
entries.cause: .value access is not compiler-safe
entries.fix: Use .get() and .set()

entries.symptom: Gesture callbacks never fire after the SDK 58 upgrade, or gestures cannot be composed
entries.cause: RNGH 3 renames onStart->onActivate, onEnd->onDeactivate, merges onChange into onUpdate, and hook-based gestures cannot relate to builder gestures
entries.fix: Keep gestures behind useBoardGestures and move all of a board's gestures to hooks in one commit

entries.symptom: React Compiler skips a hook: "value blocks within a try/catch"
entries.cause: The compiler bails out on some try/catch shapes
entries.fix: Move frame bodies into runner functions

entries.symptom: The simulator never exceeds 60 fps; a 120 Hz loop measured 115.9 ticks/s
entries.cause: The simulator is capped at 60 fps; CADisplayLink timing differs
entries.fix: Count ticks, never wall time; the owner checks 120 Hz and real-time speed on a ProMotion iPhone with the frame recorder

entries.symptom: Text is missing in Jest golden images or headless renders
entries.cause: Skia's jestSetup mocks useFonts and matchFont to null
entries.fix: Load the TTF with Skia.Typeface.MakeFreeTypeFaceFromData in text golden tests

entries.symptom: Maximum update depth exceeded after reading a store
entries.cause: A Zustand v5 selector returned a new object or array on every call
entries.fix: Return primitives or stable references, or wrap the selector in useShallow from zustand/shallow

entries.symptom: Icons such as mail, globe, theme and eye render filled solid
entries.cause: The path union comes back even-odd
entries.fix: Apply AsWinding after the union (build-icon-paths.ts does)

entries.symptom: withSpring feels heavy and slow
entries.cause: Reanimated 4.5.1's withSpring default mass is 4
entries.fix: Pass mass: 1 (Toybox motion tokens)

entries.symptom: The phone stays warm while nothing moves
entries.cause: A Picture that reads the clock re-records every frame
entries.fix: Stop the frame callback when no track is active; pause on background, ads and focus loss

entries.symptom: Swipes feel wrong or taps wait
entries.cause: Thresholds (24 pt, 600 pt/s, 1.2 ratio, 450 ms long press) are unvalidated; composition order matters
entries.fix: Tune per game on a device; Exclusive(pan, longPress, tap) must be tested so taps do not wait

entries.symptom: Plural forms wrong, Intl.PluralRules or Intl.Locale undefined, -u-nu- digits ignored, fa dates in the Solar Hijri calendar
entries.cause: Native Hermes implements only Collator, DateTimeFormat and NumberFormat, drops the numbering system, and uses a Persian calendar for fa
entries.fix: Always force the FormatJS polyfills (getcanonicallocales, locale, pluralrules, numberformat with en/de/fa/ckb data) first in the entry and in Jest; never call Intl.DateTimeFormat or toLocale* in app code

entries.symptom: eslint-plugin-formatjs never reports ICU problems in our catalogs
entries.cause: Its content rules skip calls without defaultMessage; messages live only in JSON behind t()
entries.fix: Register t/T through settings.formatjs, and run the project catalog linter (verify-catalogs.ts) plus formatjs verify --structural-equality

entries.symptom: formatjs/enforce-id demands hash IDs
entries.cause: idInterpolationPattern requires defaultMessage and hashed ids, which conflicts with semantic keys
entries.fix: Use enforce-id without the pattern, or drop it

entries.symptom: A component test throws on a missing message
entries.cause: In tests the i18n onError throws, so a missing key fails the test run
entries.fix: Add the key to every catalog (en, de, fa, ckb) and rerun i18n:verify

entries.symptom: Latin or Persian text stays left-aligned in RTL
entries.cause: textAlign 'auto' stays physical left on iOS unless the app language itself is RTL; 'left' is swapped to start
entries.fix: AppText sets writingDirection and textAlign 'left' (start); 'right' means end

entries.symptom: forceRTL(true) has no visible effect
entries.cause: I18nManager changes apply on the next JS load
entries.fix: allowRTL(desired) + forceRTL(desired), save first (the reload discards in-memory state), then reloadAppAsync() from the 'expo' package (never expo-updates, which is banned)

entries.symptom: The save is written twice on a direction switch
entries.cause: Module-level code runs once before the reload
entries.fix: Run the direction check first in the entry, before the database writes

entries.symptom: Direction flips back or disagrees with the saved language
entries.cause: I18nManager.isRTL is a constant captured at JS load and persists natively (drifts after a device restore)
entries.fix: Compute desired direction from the saved language; correct drift at startup; derive navigator direction from I18nManager

entries.symptom: expo-localization forces RTL from the device language
entries.cause: Its supportsRTL / forcesRTL plugin options set RCTI18nUtil at every module creation
entries.fix: Configure only supportedLocales (en, de, fa, ckb); leave supportsRTL and forcesRTL unset

entries.symptom: The consent form or purchase sheet shows English in a Persian game
entries.cause: Google UMP and StoreKit sheets follow the device or per-app iOS language, not the in-app choice
entries.fix: Nothing to fix in v1; tell the owner

entries.symptom: Metro fails on import(`./locale-data/${lang}`)
entries.cause: Metro cannot bundle template-string dynamic imports
entries.fix: Import the four locale files statically

entries.symptom: Tofu boxes around interpolated names
entries.cause: A font lacks FSI U+2068 / PDI U+2069
entries.fix: Vazirmatn renders them invisibly (verified); check each new font

entries.symptom: Marks of Persian or Sorani text are clipped
entries.cause: Arabic-script text needs more line height
entries.fix: About 1.5x line height for fa/ckb; check in screenshots

entries.symptom: A character renders as tofu in fa/ckb
entries.cause: Vazirmatn lacks U+061C ALM and U+1E9E; Lilita One lacks capital sharp s and tnum
entries.fix: Avoid those characters or pick the fallback font; Noto Sans Arabic is the verified backup

entries.symptom: Two spellings of Sorani December
entries.cause: CLDR 48 is inconsistent
entries.fix: The catalog uses the second form pending native review (owner step G7)

entries.symptom: Sorani not detected on a real device
entries.cause: iOS may report ckb or ku-Arab
entries.fix: resolveLanguage handles both (ku with Arab script -> ckb)

entries.symptom: Ad error handling breaks after an AdMob update
entries.cause: Legacy error code strings are deprecated (removed in v18)
entries.fix: Branch on error.phase then error.reason

entries.symptom: No consent form appears in the EEA on a real device
entries.cause: No published GDPR message in AdMob (owner step), or cached consent
entries.fix: Owner publishes the message (O9); in test builds use debug geography EEA plus AdsConsent.reset()

entries.symptom: Consent debug settings in a store build
entries.cause: debugGeography and AdsConsent.reset() were not gated by the variant
entries.fix: Reach them only through test-only code; unit-test the gate

entries.symptom: The banner never appears
entries.cause: Offline, Premium, consent not given, ADS_MODE=off, or no fill
entries.fix: Check shouldShowBanner inputs in the debug menu; open the Ad Inspector in a test build

entries.symptom: canRequestAds stays false
entries.cause: The player refused consent where that blocks ads
entries.fix: Expected; the Ad privacy choices row lets them change it

entries.symptom: An interstitial covers the Result screen
entries.cause: The call sits in the result effect instead of the button handler
entries.fix: Only the Next / Replay / Try again handlers call showInterstitialIfDue

entries.symptom: A banner test passes undefined as the size
entries.cause: The mock lacked BannerAdSize.LARGE_ANCHORED_ADAPTIVE_BANNER (ANCHORED_ADAPTIVE_BANNER is deprecated)
entries.fix: The root mock lists both sizes

entries.symptom: Ad error reason ad-already-used
entries.cause: A fullscreen ad object was shown twice
entries.fix: Use each ad object once and destroy it after CLOSED

entries.symptom: App Review rejection risk under guideline 5.1.2
entries.cause: The AdMob SDK's privacy manifest declares DeviceID with tracking=true while the app never shows ATT
entries.fix: Owner decides the App Privacy answers together with the no-ATT choice (G3)

entries.symptom: The app asks for tracking permission, or Info.plist has NSUserTrackingUsageDescription
entries.cause: userTrackingUsageDescription was passed to the AdMob plugin, or expo-tracking-transparency was installed
entries.fix: No tracking prompt in v1 (decision D4): remove both; the owner decides any change

entries.symptom: Apple emails about missing required-reason APIs
entries.cause: Apple does not reliably parse the privacy manifests of static CocoaPods
entries.fix: Aggregate every pod manifest into ios.privacyManifests; audit:privacy fails on a gap

entries.symptom: SKTestSession in an XCUITest runner does not control the app; products stay []
entries.cause: The UI-test runner is a separate process; xcodebuild test ignores the scheme StoreKit configuration
entries.fix: A hosted XCTest bundle (TEST_HOST = the app) arms storekitd for the bundle ID; then launch the app normally

entries.symptom: StoreKit testing fails silently
entries.cause: The app was built without the get-task-allow entitlement
entries.fix: Debug-only get-task-allow for the harness build; the release gate proves it absent from Release

entries.symptom: Premium disappears right after a purchase
entries.cause: A just-bought purchase is briefly missing from Transaction.currentEntitlements; the foreground re-check fires after the sheet closes
entries.fix: Revoke only on a verified transaction with revocationDate; absence keeps the cached state

entries.symptom: restorePurchases throws ErrorCode 'sync-error'
entries.cause: AppStore.sync failed or the Apple Account prompt was cancelled
entries.fix: Map it to a 'couldn't restore' state, never 'nothing to restore'

entries.symptom: The Premium price never loads, no error
entries.cause: fetchProducts returns [] silently when StoreKit cannot resolve the product
entries.fix: Map an empty result to 'store unavailable'

entries.symptom: A refund in the test store does not reach the running app
entries.cause: The test store did not push an update; only the launch re-check saw the revocation
entries.fix: Handle both paths (Transaction.updates and the launch check)

entries.symptom: SKTestSession.failTransactionsEnabled is marked deprecated
entries.cause: Deprecated since iOS 17
entries.fix: Still works for the harness; watch for its replacement

entries.symptom: Game music starts over the player's own music
entries.cause: react-native-audio-api has no API for "other audio is playing"
entries.fix: Keep game music off by default (or a small local module reading secondaryAudioShouldBeSilencedHint); never activelyReclaimSession

entries.symptom: Haptics do not change with iosAllowHaptics
entries.cause: The option only affects recording sessions
entries.fix: Leave it at its default with the ambient category

entries.symptom: Haptics cannot be felt in the simulator
entries.cause: The simulator has no Taptic Engine
entries.fix: The owner checks haptics on a device; the adapter only proves calls succeed

entries.symptom: react-native-audio-api's compatibility table stops at RN 0.85
entries.cause: The docs lag the releases
entries.fix: 0.13.6 built and played on RN 0.86.3 (verified); re-run the audio smoke on every bump

entries.symptom: null in expo.extra arrives as {} on the device
entries.cause: Expo serialises extra through the manifest
entries.fix: Omit keys instead of null (withShell omits adUnits unless present)

entries.symptom: A banner inside a zero-height container may never load
entries.cause: Unverified whether GMA loads a collapsed banner
entries.fix: Use the off-screen transparent fallback until the first ADS_MODE=test smoke settles it

entries.symptom: The App Privacy questionnaire cannot be filled by the agent
entries.cause: It is believed to be web-only
entries.fix: Owner step G3, using audit:privacy output

entries.symptom: The runtime socket audit sees WebKit traffic
entries.cause: Ads render in WKWebView whose traffic can come from com.apple.WebKit.Networking; StoreKit traffic goes through a system daemon
entries.fix: Run the runtime audit with ADS_MODE=off; StoreKit is allowed

entries.symptom: zod crashes or refuses to run on Hermes in Release
entries.cause: zod 4's JIT uses new Function
entries.fix: Use valibot 1.5.0 for the save document

entries.symptom: expo-sqlite fails in Jest
entries.cause: The native module does not run in Jest
entries.fix: Keep SQL behind a SqlDriver; test the real DDL on node:sqlite in root test/integration; the simulator kill test is the final check

entries.symptom: App crashes at boot after installing an older TestFlight build (save.db from a newer app)
entries.cause: An older createSqliteSaveStore threw when PRAGMA user_version was newer than DB_STRUCTURE_VERSION, so every launch crashed before the first frame
entries.fix: Use the current save-persistence-and-migrations templates: the SQLite store returns a read-only store with newerStructureVersion(), hydrateSave passes it to planLoad, and the session plays in memory with the newer-version outcome ("please update"); check-save-layer reports a throw as newer-db-crash
match: save\.db structure v\d+ is newer than this app

entries.symptom: Both save slots are unreadable
entries.cause: The spec defines only "a backup copy was restored"
entries.fix: Quarantine the rows, start fresh, show "Your progress couldn't be loaded." (needs a catalog key and translations)

entries.symptom: A device backup restores an older save
entries.cause: Data sits in save.db-wal
entries.fix: Run PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE) when the app goes to the background (verified: -wal drops to 0 bytes)

entries.symptom: Progress lost although Back opens Pause
entries.cause: usePreventRemove does not catch app close, an OS kill, or screens unmounted by a groups.if flip
entries.fix: Save after every move; Back-opens-Pause is UX only

entries.symptom: Push animations may slide the wrong way in RTL with headerShown false
entries.cause: Not checked visually (the source says native-stack passes direction)
entries.fix: Owner RTL play-test confirms pushes slide from the reading direction

entries.symptom: Reduce motion on, screens still slide
entries.cause: The static navigator always uses the platform push animation
entries.fix: Set animation: 'fade' from the reduce-motion setting (screen options or setOptions); not designed yet

entries.symptom: Navigator direction disagrees with layout for one launch
entries.cause: Direction was derived from the language setting, not I18nManager
entries.fix: Derive direction from I18nManager.getConstants().isRTL (NavigationContainer default)

entries.symptom: Back on the Game screen was checked only by tsc and source reading
entries.cause: No runtime test yet
entries.fix: Add an RNTL test with the real navigator: goBack shows Pause, again resumes, Pause -> Home saves

entries.symptom: After Reset statistics, level and daily cards still show numbers
entries.cause: They are derived from progress and daily results
entries.fix: Owner decides whether Reset statistics needs its own baselines

entries.symptom: A lost daily attempt still extends the streak
entries.cause: The first finished attempt counts
entries.fix: If the owner wants wins only, change recordDailyResult's caller, not the model

entries.symptom: A 1 pt shift, a lighter weight or a wrong string passes a pixel-percentage gate; a colour change is invisible in the heatmap
entries.cause: Global pixelmatch % and SSIM noise floors (0.13-0.51 %, 0.983-0.995) overlap real defects; threshold 0.1 misses #1F5FBF -> #3B6FD0
entries.fix: Gate per element by testID: geometry ±2 pt, exact strings, fill Δ≤3 per channel, text ink metrics, aligned crop structure; report global numbers only

entries.symptom: A design screenshot comes out 1206x2625 instead of 1206x2622
entries.cause: An element screenshot of an in-flow frame sat on a fractional CSS offset
entries.fix: Pin the frame at (0,0) with position fixed and clip the page screenshot

entries.symptom: Design references change between runs or machines
entries.cause: The design HTML loads Google Fonts at run time; offline it falls back to system fonts
entries.fix: Vendor the exact TTFs the app bundles and load them with @font-face

entries.symptom: Exact parity impossible although every check was tuned
entries.cause: Different fonts, icon sources and renderers, and palette-quantised references (the earlier project passed 6 of 112)
entries.fix: Same TTFs, same icon paths, same device geometry, lossless references, element-level checks, and a proven human look

entries.symptom: A correct Persian screen fails a full-screen structural diff
entries.cause: Sub-point rounding adds up to a 1 pt drift further down the screen
entries.fix: Compute structural diffs per element after an alignment search (±6 px), blobs ≥1.5 pt

entries.symptom: Text sits up to 1.7 pt lower than in the design
entries.cause: RN line-height placement differs from CSS half-leading
entries.fix: Allow ±2 pt on text position; check ink width and height at ±1 pt

entries.symptom: Every element is 8 pt too low compared with the design
entries.cause: The design frame is 390x844 with a 54 pt status bar; the iPhone 16/17 Pro is 402x874 with a 62 pt safe top
entries.fix: Render the design at the device geometry (402x874, 62 pt status bar) and mask the top safe area

entries.symptom: The design has a home indicator the screenshot lacks
entries.cause: simctl screenshots include the Dynamic Island but never the home indicator
entries.fix: Hide .hi in the design render; do not mask the bottom

entries.symptom: Automated parity passed but a human found blockers
entries.cause: Machines cannot judge icons, shadows, optical alignment or RTL mirroring; earlier only 4 of 112 sheets were ever read
entries.fix: Read every side-by-side sheet and sign it off; tie the sign-off to the sheet hash

entries.symptom: A screen passes only after a tolerance was raised
entries.cause: Widening a tolerance to pass is falsifying the test
entries.fix: Never widen tolerances or regenerate references to clear a failure; fix the app

entries.symptom: A commit is rejected: gate files changed without a Gate-Change trailer
entries.cause: The commit-msg hook requires Gate-Change: <reason> for gated paths
entries.fix: Get the owner's agreement, then commit the gate change with the trailer

entries.symptom: Commit rejected: "Updated stuff." or feat(ui): ...
entries.cause: Conventional Commits with a folder scope are required
entries.fix: feat(line-siege): ..., scope = a folder under apps/ or packages/, or one of repo, deps, docs, ci, skills

entries.symptom: Commit refused by no-secrets (AuthKey_*.p8, *.p12, .env)
entries.cause: Key and signing files are never committed, even with git add -f
entries.fix: Remove the file from the commit; keys live outside the repo

entries.symptom: Lint errors after an edit never reach Claude
entries.cause: A PostToolUse hook that exits 0 or 1 is not shown to Claude
entries.fix: Print to stderr and exit 2

entries.symptom: The Stop hook keeps blocking and Claude stops anyway
entries.cause: The Stop hook blocks at most 8 consecutive continuations (CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP)
entries.fix: Read stop_hook_active; after the cap, report the failing gate to the owner instead of working around it

entries.symptom: Pre-commit typecheck passes although a package has errors
entries.cause: A bare tsc --noEmit checks only the root program
entries.fix: Run npm run -s typecheck (every project, incremental)

entries.symptom: A rule was switched off for one run with eslint --rule
entries.cause: The CLI flag overrides the config
entries.fix: Hooks and CI call only the canonical npm scripts

entries.symptom: check-quality-gates reports "max-params[1]: expected 3, got 5"
entries.cause: A limit in eslint.config.mjs was raised
entries.fix: Restore the limit; limits change only with the owner and a Gate-Change trailer

entries.symptom: Skill permissions or the Expo plugin entry vanished from .claude/settings.json
entries.cause: The file was replaced instead of merged
entries.fix: Merge keys; the edit asks the owner

entries.symptom: Project allow rules are ignored: "Dropped 2 project-scoped permissions.allow entries - workspace not yet trusted"
entries.cause: Claude Code drops project allow rules until the workspace is trusted
entries.fix: The owner accepts the trust dialog in the project folder once

entries.symptom: Large-text screenshots look unscaled
entries.cause: content_size categories map to font scales (large 1.0, accessibility-medium 1.786, accessibility-extra-extra-extra-large 3.571)
entries.fix: Use simctl ui <udid> content_size accessibility-extra-extra-extra-large for the 200% pass; cap with maxFontSizeMultiplier 2

entries.symptom: checkPaletteContrast fails every light Toybox palette
entries.cause: It requires primary/background, starOn/surface ≥3 and danger/background ≥4.5, which Toybox light palettes miss by design
entries.fix: Proposal: check border/background and border/primary ≥3 and danger/surface ≥4.5 (owner decision)

entries.symptom: The hold-to-confirm label is 4.43:1 during the hold (needs 4.5)
entries.cause: 17 pt bold danger text on dangerFill in light
entries.fix: Owner chooses: a lighter dangerFill (#FFDFE2 gives 4.62:1) or accept it as a transient state

entries.symptom: boxShadow or outline looks different on device
entries.cause: Not verified on the simulator yet
entries.fix: Check in the first simulator build; the fallback is the RaisedSurface shadow View

entries.symptom: JS-only cold-start timing looks fast but launch feels slow
entries.cause: JS timing misses about 90% of the launch on the simulator
entries.fix: Measure process start to first frame with the native ProcessStart module (median 539 ms over 66 launches)

entries.symptom: A budget fails on a real device
entries.cause: The 6 MB bundle, 150 MB memory and 1,000 draw-call budgets are first estimates from probes
entries.fix: Tighten after the pilot game's first owner report, with a Gate-Change trailer

entries.symptom: Cold start over 1 s on an older iPhone
entries.cause: The forced FormatJS polyfills cost about 11 ms on the Mac simulator, more on old phones; bundle grows about 0.9 MB
entries.fix: Measure on a device before changing the polyfill policy

entries.symptom: A skill placed in a grouping sub-folder, two levels below .claude/skills, never appears
entries.cause: Skills are discovered exactly one folder deep
entries.fix: Keep skills/<name>/SKILL.md and link .claude/skills/<name> to it

entries.symptom: The skill is listed with the description "---"
entries.cause: The opening --- is not line 1 (blank line or BOM before it), so the whole file became the body
entries.fix: Put --- on line 1

entries.symptom: The skill is listed with its first body line as description
entries.cause: The frontmatter YAML does not parse, so every field is dropped silently
entries.fix: Keep one-line values; quote values containing ": " or " #"

entries.symptom: Claude says to type /name instead of using the skill the owner named
entries.cause: disable-model-invocation: true removes the description and blocks the Skill tool
entries.fix: Never use disable-model-invocation on Pocket Arcade skills

entries.symptom: A skill with paths: is missing from the listing and /name does nothing
entries.cause: paths hides the skill until a matching file is read
entries.fix: Do not use paths on skills the owner names

entries.symptom: Claude's Skill call is denied in headless runs (permission_denials: [Skill])
entries.cause: A skill with allowed-tools or hooks needs approval to be invoked by Claude; Skill(prefix-*) wildcards do not match
entries.fix: No allowed-tools; allow the scripts with a project Bash rule instead

entries.symptom: Shell command failed for pattern ... and the skill never loads
entries.cause: A !`command` in SKILL.md exited non-zero or was not pre-approved
entries.fix: Run checks as normal Bash calls from the instructions, not as injected commands

entries.symptom: Some skills show only their name, no description
entries.cause: The skill listing exceeded its character budget (30,000 at the default 0.01) and dropped the least-used descriptions
entries.fix: skillListingBudgetFraction 0.04 in .claude/settings.json; keep descriptions ≤300 characters

entries.symptom: After a long session a skill's later sections are forgotten
entries.cause: After compaction only the first 5,000 tokens of each invoked skill are re-attached (25,000 in total)
entries.fix: Keep rules and the definition of done near the top; re-invoke the skill before verifying

entries.symptom: Every write under .claude/ asks for approval
entries.cause: .claude/ is a protected path
entries.fix: Author skills in skills/<name> and link .claude/skills/<name> once (link-skills.mjs)

entries.symptom: @references/x.md in SKILL.md is not attached
entries.cause: Only @ paths that start with the skill-folder variable are attached automatically
entries.fix: Link references normally and say when to read each one

entries.symptom: A skill named verify/run/debug replaced a bundled command
entries.cause: Same-name project skills shadow bundled ones
entries.fix: Never use bundled names (verify, run, debug, loop, init, review, code-review, simplify, security-review)

entries.symptom: A skill script path works in one session and not another
entries.cause: Injected and Bash commands run in the session folder, not the skill folder
entries.fix: Always call scripts through the skill-folder variable: node <skill dir>/scripts/<x>.mjs

entries.symptom: The first API-key archive cannot create the Apple Development certificate
entries.cause: Unverified whether the key alone can create it on this Mac
entries.fix: Owner step O7: sign in once in Xcode > Settings > Accounts

entries.symptom: The upload JSON has no obvious delivery ID, or build-status --wait returns early
entries.cause: Unverified without the owner key: the delivery-ID field name, whether --build-status --wait waits for VALID, the --beta-app-store-text folder layout, whether altool --list-apps needs --provider-public-id, and the exit code of security show-keychain-info on a locked keychain
entries.fix: Search the JSON for a delivery key, poll REST processingState, set What to Test through REST; record the real answers after the first release

entries.symptom: A store simulator build has nothing to wait on before the screenshot
entries.cause: App code cannot log and store builds have no perf log
entries.fix: Decided: two identical screenshots after at least 3 s (build-ios-sim.ts)

entries.symptom: A fresh Mac has no Java 17 for Maestro
entries.cause: This Mac uses Android Studio's JBR; mise temurin-17 is listed but not verified
entries.fix: mise use java@temurin-17 and point JAVA_HOME at it; verify on first use

entries.symptom: The Expo Claude plugin nudges toward EAS services
entries.cause: The template enables expo@claude-plugins-official
entries.fix: Owner decides whether to keep it; if kept, AGENTS.md forbids EAS and OTA

entries.symptom: No licence-compatible fa/ckb word lists for Letter Bugs
entries.cause: Many open dictionaries are GPL, LGPL or MPL, which the licence allowlist rejects
entries.fix: Owner decides the source; build Letter Bugs late

entries.symptom: The Premium price tier (EUR 1.90 vs 1.99) is not settled
entries.cause: Apple price points were not checked (no key)
entries.fix: The IAP script refuses to guess and asks the owner (D3)

entries.symptom: Interstitial frequency after losses may not match the owner's intent
entries.cause: Spec 8.8 read as: no two consecutive interstitials both after a loss
entries.fix: If the owner meant otherwise, change only shouldShowInterstitial and its test

entries.symptom: The first Shell session does not know the exact create-expo-app command and files to delete
entries.cause: Not fixed by any doc
entries.fix: Record the commands used during bootstrap

entries.symptom: Unclear whether to push
entries.cause: The owner has not said whether a remote or pull requests are used
entries.fix: Treat pushing as outward-facing: ask first

entries.symptom: Flat PNG icons do not get per-layer Liquid Glass depth
entries.cause: The Icon Composer .icon format has no documented schema
entries.fix: Ship flat light, dark and tinted PNGs; revisit if the owner wants layers

entries.symptom: fa and ckb strings may wrap differently after review
entries.cause: The copy deck is a draft awaiting native review
entries.fix: Re-check S2, S4 keys and stickers after the review

entries.symptom: xcrun: error: unable to find utility "simctl"
entries.cause: DEVELOPER_DIR points at the Command Line Tools, not at an Xcode app
entries.fix: Use selectXcode(); the developer dir must end in Xcode-26.6.0.app/Contents/Developer

entries.symptom: No .xcworkspace in apps/<game>/ios after prebuild
entries.cause: Prebuild stopped early on a config error
entries.fix: Read apps/<game>/build/logs/prebuild.log, fix the config error, rerun the clean prebuild

entries.symptom: ** BUILD FAILED ** with a Swift or C++ error inside a pod
entries.cause: A native module and the SDK disagree, usually after a hand-made version change
entries.fix: npx expo install --check in the app, restore the pinned versions, clean prebuild

entries.symptom: The disk is full, or a simulator will not boot
entries.cause: Old DerivedData, build folders, runtimes and unavailable simulators
entries.fix: rm -rf apps/*/build and xcrun simctl delete unavailable; never erase simulators the tooling did not create

entries.symptom: Unable to boot device in current state: Booted
entries.cause: The simulator was booted twice
entries.fix: Harmless; use simctl bootstatus <udid> -b, which boots only when needed
match: Unable to boot device in current state: Booted

entries.symptom: the app was not ready after 30 s
entries.cause: A JS error before Home, or a test build whose perf log never got cold-start (a first-run install never reaches Home, so its launch has a perf log but no cold-start entry)
entries.fix: Copy ios-simulator-build's current packages/tooling/src/build/build-ios-sim.ts (after 8 s without a cold-start entry it falls back to a still screen, which a first-run install needs); otherwise open the last screenshot, relaunch, and read the debug menu error log (test builds) or simctl spawn <udid> log show --last 2m --predicate 'process == "<Executable>"'

entries.symptom: The screenshot is white or one flat colour (not the React Navigation grey)
entries.cause: The app crashed at launch or drew nothing
entries.fix: Read the process log with simctl spawn ... log show; check GADApplicationIdentifier, the embedded main.jsbundle and JS errors

entries.symptom: simctl launch ... -AppleLanguages "(fa)" still shows the app in English or LTR
entries.cause: The app does not declare the language in CFBundleLocalizations, or the argument arrived as one word
entries.fix: Configure expo-localization supportedLocales (en, de, fa, ckb) so prebuild writes CFBundleLocalizations; pass each launch argument as its own word

entries.symptom: An app whose main.jsbundle was swapped for fast iteration fails to install or launch
entries.cause: The bundle changed after the app was signed
entries.fix: After copying the new bundle run codesign --force --sign - --deep <App>.app, then simctl install and launch; the evidence build is always the full Release run

entries.symptom: store-artifact gate failed
entries.cause: The exported .ipa has test code, a test artefact (StoreKit file, harness), the sample AdMob ID, a stale build number or get-task-allow
entries.fix: Fix the cause the message names, rebuild with a new build number; never skip the gate

entries.symptom: processing did not reach VALID within 60 minutes
entries.cause: Apple is slow, or the build is stuck
entries.fix: Check the TestFlight tab in App Store Connect, then rerun release:ios with --resume processing (the upload is done; it waits for VALID, sets What to Test and tags without uploading again)

entries.symptom: release:ios stops after the upload with "... while waiting for processing" or "reading the processing state failed"
entries.cause: A REST error (401/403 or no network) while polling processing; the build is already at Apple
entries.fix: A 401 or 403 is an owner stop (O3); otherwise restore the network. Then rerun release:ios with --resume processing; a plain rerun would upload a second build

entries.symptom: The build is VALID but does not appear in TestFlight on the owner's iPhone
entries.cause: TestFlight shows a build only to testers in a group that has it; the app has no internal tester group with automatic distribution
entries.fix: Owner step (with G2): the app > TestFlight > Internal Testing > +, name Owner, automatic distribution on, add themself; later builds then appear without another step

entries.symptom: release:ios --resume stops with: cannot resume: HEAD is "...", not "chore(<game>): build <n>" (or: build <n> is already tagged)
entries.cause: A commit came after the build-number bump (usually the fix itself), or that build already finished and was tagged
entries.fix: Rerun release:ios without --resume; it takes a new build number (gaps are harmless, Apple rejects only duplicates)

entries.symptom: App Store Connect offers no Persian or Sorani localization for the store page, What to Test or the Premium product
entries.cause: Apple's App Store localization list has neither language
entries.fix: Store texts in en-US and de-DE only; the in-app languages are unaffected

entries.symptom: The Premium in-app purchase cannot be submitted on its own
entries.cause: The first non-consumable must be submitted with a new app version
entries.fix: The owner selects Premium on the version page before Submit for Review (step R5); later IAPs can use inAppPurchaseSubmissions

entries.symptom: react-native-svg or @shopify/flash-list appears in a package.json
entries.cause: react-native-svg adds a native pod and a fetch-based SvgUri; FlashList is not needed (benchmarked)
entries.fix: Icons are Skia paths and lists are ScrollView/FlatList; keep both out (the import ban already rejects them; add them to the banned-package list)

entries.symptom: eslint-plugin-react-native blocks an ESLint upgrade
entries.cause: It has had no release since December 2024 and caps its peer range at ESLint 9
entries.fix: Drop the plugin when it blocks an upgrade; its rules are nice-to-have

entries.symptom: knip reports a package as unused although the app needs it
entries.cause: The package is used only through an app.config.ts plugin entry or native code
entries.fix: Check first that the package is really used (an app.config.ts plugin entry or native code). Then add it to the app's ignoreDependencies only with the owner's agreement, a Gate-Change: trailer and its reason in quality-gates' root-files reference (knip.json cannot hold comments; check-gate-wiring fails an undocumented entry as knip-ignores)

entries.symptom: expo/no-dynamic-env-var inside packages/shell/src
entries.cause: process.env['X'] or a computed env name; Expo inlines only literal dot access
entries.fix: Pass process.env into withShell from app.config.ts and read the variable there; in app code use process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_X literally

entries.symptom: @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports in packages/shell/src/app/test-only.ts
entries.cause: The one file-level exemption is missing from eslint.config.mjs
entries.fix: The config exempts exactly packages/shell/src/app/test-only.ts; nothing else may require()

entries.symptom: max-lines fails on a level pack, palette or catalog file
entries.cause: Large data tables were written as TypeScript
entries.fix: Move data to JSON (import ... with { type: 'json' }) or add a named exemption with the owner; split code by responsibility, not by line count

entries.symptom: New react-hooks errors appear after a dependency bump
entries.cause: Compiler rules arrive with eslint-plugin-react-hooks minor versions
entries.fix: Run lint after every bump and fix the code; never turn the rule off

entries.symptom: A clock adapter, direction module, AppText or external-links file suddenly fails lint
entries.cause: The ESLint exemptions name exact files; the file was renamed or moved
entries.fix: Keep the canonical file names; if a rename is right, change the exemption glob with the owner and a Gate-Change trailer

entries.symptom: A tsconfig copied from the Expo TypeScript guide sets baseUrl and paths
entries.cause: The guide's example lags the template
entries.fix: Copy the template form (extends expo/tsconfig.base, no baseUrl); cross-package imports use @e07/<package>/<path>.ts

entries.symptom: Haptics calls end in .catch(() => undefined), which looks like a swallowed error
entries.cause: Expo documents haptics as a no-op in Low Power Mode and similar states
entries.fix: Kept as the one allowed fallback (a stack decision) inside the haptics adapter; everywhere else errors are recorded

entries.symptom: max-params fails on draw(canvas, view, fx, colors, layout)
entries.cause: The renderer contract has five inputs and the limit is three
entries.fix: Use draw(canvas, frame) with frame = { view, fx, colors, layout, kit }

entries.symptom: jest -u writes golden snapshots to *.snap.ios files that the gate does not know
entries.cause: The jest-expo/ios preset adds the platform suffix next to the test
entries.fix: Keep **/*.golden.test.ts.snap.ios in gatedPaths (add *.snap.android when Android starts); commit with a Gate-Change trailer

entries.symptom: Simulator screenshot baselines differ after an Xcode or iOS runtime change
entries.cause: Rendering differs across iOS runtime versions
entries.fix: Tie baselines to one device model and runtime (iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch (M5), iOS 26.5) and regenerate them deliberately with a Gate-Change trailer

entries.symptom: Stryker leaves NoCoverage at premium-reducer.ts:22 and a survivor at line 27
entries.cause: No example dispatches connect-started, and replacing state.flow.kind === 'loading' with true survives
entries.fix: Add one example for each when the reducer is implemented

entries.symptom: An E2E flow cannot find game.board-layout, so board taps have no coordinates
entries.cause: The board host does not render the test-build board-layout element yet
entries.fix: game-board-host.tsx renders game.board-layout in test builds when launched with boardLayout=1

entries.symptom: npm run e2e:ios reports no cold-start or memory numbers and always uses the large text size
entries.cause: run-e2e-ios.ts has no cold-start/footprint step and no --text-size option yet
entries.fix: Add both to run-e2e-ios.ts so the a11y pass needs no hand-run commands (screenshots:ios already has --text-size)

entries.symptom: The first storekit-harness.ts run on the pilot app fails at Metro readiness or flow order
entries.cause: The Tier-2 runner and its seven flows were verified step by step, never as a whole
entries.fix: Run it once on the pilot, fix the order or wait, and record the result

entries.symptom: runOnJS logs a deprecation warning, or code from memory uses runOnJS and .value
entries.cause: Worklets 0.10 deprecates runOnJS; the React Compiler needs shared-value accessors
entries.fix: Use scheduleOnRN(fn, ...args) from react-native-worklets and .get()/.set()

entries.symptom: Skia logs a deprecation warning for moveTo, addCircle or transform
entries.cause: Skia 2.6 moved to immutable paths; the old SkPath mutators still work but will be removed
