entries.fix: Build paths once with Skia.PathBuilder.Make()...build() at unit size and place them with canvas.save/translate/scale/restore

entries.symptom: A worklet keeps using an old value after JS changed it
entries.cause: Values captured by a worklet are copied when it is first scheduled
entries.fix: Pass anything that changes through a shared value; no promises, await, setTimeout or third-party code in worklets

entries.symptom: The board freezes after an exception inside a frame callback
entries.cause: An uncaught error on the UI thread stops the callback silently
entries.fix: Every frame body is one call into runBoardFrame/runLoopFrame, which wraps it in try/catch, stops the callback and reports through scheduleOnRN so the game pauses and records the error

entries.symptom: A fast ball passes through a wall or a corner hit bounces wrong
entries.cause: Discrete steps skip thin obstacles at high speed
entries.fix: Swept collision tests, a small fixed step and properties such as "never leaves the arena" and "energy never increases"

entries.symptom: RTL behaviour changes after the SDK 58 upgrade
entries.cause: Expo's localization guide says RTL defaults change in SDK 58
entries.fix: Re-run the RTL probe screen and screenshots after the upgrade

entries.symptom: The Numbers setting has no visible effect in English or German
entries.cause: All three options produce Latin digits for en/de
entries.fix: Kept as the spec asks, with live previews; the owner may hide it for en/de

entries.symptom: release:ios refuses a store build: fa/ckb messages differ from their reviewed hash
entries.cause: Changed Persian or Sorani texts have not been reviewed by a native speaker
entries.fix: Owner step: review (review-sheet.ts) or record a waiver ("reviewer": "waived-by-owner") with a Gate-Change trailer

entries.symptom: Consent update fails while offline and no ads show later although consent was given
entries.cause: The UMP request needs the network
entries.fix: Use canRequestAds from the earlier session when the update fails; adPolicy's online input suppresses ads while offline

entries.symptom: Lint rejects importing AdsConsent in the consent adapter
entries.cause: The rule was written as "one adapter imports the SDK", but ConsentPort needs the same package
entries.fix: Two adapter files may import it: admob-ads-adapter.ts and admob-consent-adapter.ts

entries.symptom: Premium might be revoked or missing when checking entitlements offline
entries.cause: Whether Transaction.currentEntitlements is complete offline is not verified
entries.fix: An error keeps the cached Premium state; only a verified revocation removes it

entries.symptom: The StoreKitHarness target is missing after a prebuild
entries.cause: prebuild regenerates ios/; the harness is added by storekit-harness.ts (xcodeproj gem) after a fresh test prebuild, not by a config plugin
entries.fix: Run the harness step after every test-variant prebuild; never in store builds

entries.symptom: audit:network flags a package that only one game uses
entries.cause: js-baseline.json and native-baseline.json are shared by all games
entries.fix: Add the entry with a reason; split the baselines per app (network-audit/<game-id>/) if games diverge a lot

entries.symptom: The S11d licences screen has no list of shipped npm packages
entries.cause: audit:licenses computes the set but does not write it for the app
entries.fix: Emit apps/<game>/assets/generated/npm-licences.json (name, version, SPDX) from audit:licenses

entries.symptom: Save writes get slow as the document grows
entries.cause: The whole JSON document is written on every save
entries.fix: Keep the perf test at p95 < 5 ms; past about 200 KB move the active run into its own row

entries.symptom: The status bar shows "◀ <other app>" in a screenshot
entries.cause: The app was launched while another app was in front
entries.fix: Terminate other apps first and relaunch cleanly

entries.symptom: maestro hierarchy reports the real time although the status bar is overridden
entries.cause: status_bar override changes only the pixels, not the accessibility tree
entries.fix: Mask the top safe area (62 pt) in element checks

entries.symptom: A screenshot catches a screen mid-animation
entries.cause: The capture ran before the screen settled
entries.fix: Capture every 300 ms until two in a row are identical (max 5 s); simctl captures are deterministic

entries.symptom: Stale generated icons are not caught by verify
entries.cause: render-art.ts --check is not wired into the verify script yet
entries.fix: Add node packages/tooling/src/art/render-art.ts --app <id> --check for every app with the npmScripts entry in quality-gates.json (Gate-Change)

entries.symptom: Board cells are below 44 pt at 402x874 and nothing fails
entries.cause: BoardLayout does not expose the smallest hit region yet (cell size plus 2 x HIT_SLOP of 8 pt)
entries.fix: Expose it from BoardLayout and assert >= 44 pt in each game

entries.symptom: Smart Invert changes the board colours
entries.cause: The board canvas is inverted like other content
entries.fix: Set accessibilityIgnoresInvertColors on BoardCanvas (the palette already has a dark variant)

entries.symptom: A skill in apps/<game>/.claude/skills is missing from the / menu
entries.cause: Nested skills load only after Claude reads or edits a file in that folder
entries.fix: Keep every skill at the repo root (skills/<name>, linked from .claude/skills/<name>)

entries.symptom: A skill folder named synced or anthropic-skills never loads
entries.cause: Those names are reserved
entries.fix: Rename the folder and the name field

entries.symptom: allowed_tools or disableModelInvocation has no effect
entries.cause: Unknown frontmatter keys are ignored silently
entries.fix: Use only name and description (the validator rejects other keys)

entries.symptom: The skill is listed with its first body line and is missing from init.skills
entries.cause: The description field is missing
entries.fix: Write a description of at most 300 characters: verb first, trigger words, Not for

entries.symptom: Typing /name does nothing
entries.cause: user-invocable: false hides the skill from the / menu
entries.fix: Never set user-invocable on Pocket Arcade skills

entries.symptom: A different skill loads than the one in skills/<name>
entries.cause: A personal skill with the same name has higher precedence
entries.fix: Keep names unique and project-specific

entries.symptom: A skill folder created mid-session does not appear
entries.cause: A new top-level skills folder is not watched until re-scanned
entries.fix: Run /reload-skills or start a new session

entries.symptom: A skill run returns nothing
entries.cause: context: fork on a guidelines-only skill runs it in a separate context with no task
entries.fix: No context key on Pocket Arcade skills (the validator rejects it)

entries.symptom: claude plugin validate passes a skill that is still broken
entries.cause: It checks only YAML parsing and a missing frontmatter or description
entries.fix: Run node skills/_library/validate-skills.mjs, which checks the whole standard

entries.symptom: A script's output arrives as a file path plus a preview
entries.cause: Bash output over about 30,000 characters is not shown inline
entries.fix: Checkers print short problem lines and a RESULT line; long reports go to files

entries.symptom: Family Sharing for Premium is undecided
entries.cause: Turning it on in App Store Connect cannot be undone
entries.fix: Default off; only the owner turns it on

entries.symptom: Dark mode ink, outline and shadow are tinted per game
entries.cause: The palette data tints them although the design notes say one ink
entries.fix: Follow the data (per-game tint) until the owner decides; change tokens and palettes together

entries.symptom: Display text uses the platform font at the old sizes; t.test.tsx expects heading line height 30
entries.cause: TYPE_SCALE and LATIN_SCRIPT still use the pre-Toybox sizes and fonts
entries.fix: Switch TYPE_SCALE, fonts.ts and useLocalizedTextStyle together and change the one expectation (30 -> 32)

entries.symptom: npm run new-game does not exist yet
entries.cause: No skill shipped packages/tooling/src/scaffold/new-game.ts, although monorepo-bootstrap and quality-gates wire npm run new-game to it
entries.fix: Copy new-game-scaffold templates/tooling/new-game.ts to packages/tooling/src/scaffold/new-game.ts (it forwards to scaffold-game.mjs under skills/ or .claude/skills/); check-scaffold reports it missing (new-game-script)

entries.symptom: Gestures in RTL on Android are unverified
entries.cause: Only iOS was probed; gesture coordinates are physical
entries.fix: Re-run the gesture tests and a play-test in RTL when Android starts

entries.symptom: tsc fails in a fresh repo: test-only-entry.ts (or test-only-api.ts) cannot find './debug-screen.tsx', a debug-kit file or an app/parity/ harness file
entries.cause: The shared test-only entry re-exports the S15 debug screen (toybox-screens), e2e-maestro's debug kit and the parity harness (toybox-visual-parity), which later build steps ship
entries.fix: Until a file exists, drop its export from test-only-entry.ts and its member from test-only-api.ts; never drop the SHELL_TEST_BUILD_ONLY sentinel. Copy the shared pair again once the files exist

entries.symptom: npx expo run:ios made a Debug build with the wrong Xcode
entries.cause: expo run:ios builds Debug with whatever xcode-select points at (Xcode 27 on this Mac)
entries.fix: Build with npm run build:ios:sim (Release, iphonesimulator, CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO, DEVELOPER_DIR for Xcode 26.6)

entries.symptom: The Xcode 27 readiness scan passes but the app still opens to a black screen
entries.cause: scene-support.ts was copied into the repo but withShell never calls it
entries.fix: Call the scene-support helper from withShell; the readiness scan no longer counts the helper or its test on their own

entries.symptom: npx expo config or prebuild fails to resolve the expo-splash-screen plugin
entries.cause: withGameArt adds the expo-splash-screen plugin and points the icon and splash at PNGs that exist only after the art render, but the app does not depend on the package yet (seen on the first Shell build, when withGameArt landed before the art step)
entries.fix: Before the first expo config or prebuild that includes withGameArt: node packages/tooling/src/art/render-art.ts --app <id>, then npx expo install expo-splash-screen in every apps/<game> (lockstep) and add "expo-splash-screen": "*" to the Shell peerDependencies (Shell build step 8 in pocket-arcade-index)
match: Failed to resolve plugin for module "expo-splash-screen"

entries.symptom: npm run release:ios stops with Missing script: "audit:privacy" (or "verify", "audit:network")
entries.cause: release:ios runs verify, audit:privacy and audit:network before archiving
entries.fix: Add the three npm scripts (quality-gates, privacy-and-network-audit); check-release-setup reports a missing one as release-prereqs

entries.symptom: knip reports hundreds of "Unlisted dependencies" (477) in a repo that holds skills/
entries.cause: knip's Jest plugin falls back to test patterns anywhere in the repo, so it reads skill templates and fixtures
entries.fix: Add "ignore": ["skills/**"] to knip.json and quality-gates.json (never a wider ignore); check-monorepo requires it

entries.symptom: Re-running the bootstrap scaffold reports package.json as a conflict after npm install
entries.cause: npm approve-scripts adds an allowScripts block to package.json
entries.fix: Use the current scaffold: an allowScripts-only difference counts as unchanged

entries.symptom: A package younger than 7 days installs although .npmrc sets min-release-age=7
entries.cause: npm keeps the last value, so a later min-release-age=0 switches the policy off; min-release-age-exclude = x (no [], spaces) is also honoured by npm 11.17
entries.fix: One min-release-age line; exceptions only in the dated exclude block as min-release-age-exclude[]=<pkg>@<version>; check-deps.ts in npm run verify catches both loopholes

entries.symptom: An unused app-wide native module is never reported by knip
entries.cause: The Shell's peerDependencies entry counts as a use for knip
entries.fix: Rely on dependency-management's unused-dependency rule (it checks imports); react-native-screens and react-native-safe-area-context count as used through React Navigation

entries.symptom: npm install prints "N moderate severity vulnerabilities" (23 on 2026-09-30; the count drifts) and suggests npm audit fix
entries.cause: The advisories are in build tooling (uuid through Expo config plugins, qs through Stryker); none of it ships in the app, and npm audit is not a gate
entries.fix: Never run npm audit fix (with --force it moves expo off SDK 57); review advisories with dependency-management

entries.symptom: fsevents@2.3.3 appears as a pending install script (npm approve-scripts / allowScripts) after an install
entries.cause: An optional macOS file-watcher dependency of jest-haste-map (through jest) ships a node-gyp rebuild install script; npm explain fsevents shows the path
entries.fix: Approve it like the other known install scripts (it is expected and never ships in the app), then rerun check-deps-policy

entries.symptom: it should match /^(can|[a-z]+s)\b/u  jest/valid-title
entries.cause: Test titles start with a third-person verb or 'can' (the canonical ESLint config)
entries.fix: Write it('returns …'), it('swallows …') or it('can …'), not it('return …') or it('never throws')

entries.symptom: Use toBe when expecting primitive literals (jest/prefer-to-be) in a filled logic.test.ts
entries.cause: The pinned example returns a number, string or boolean literal, and toStrictEqual is rejected for those
entries.fix: Fill the template's __EQUALITY_MATCHER__ with toBe for a primitive and toStrictEqual for an object or array

entries.symptom: Prettier or ESLint fails on folders that were in the repo before the monorepo (the owner's handbook, design and research folders)
entries.cause: An older .prettierignore ignored only the docs folder and skills/, and PRE_EXISTING in eslint.config.mjs was left empty
entries.fix: Use the current .prettierignore (adds .claude/ and the __PRE_EXISTING__ list) and fill PRE_EXISTING in eslint.config.mjs; check-configs reports ignore-pre-existing

entries.symptom: prettier --check fails on a template right after its __PLACEHOLDERS__ were filled
entries.cause: Filled values change line lengths, so the wrapping no longer matches Prettier
entries.fix: Run npx prettier --write on the filled files before lint and commit

entries.symptom: The vendor-port-adapter template fails tsc when the vendor call is async
entries.cause: The result type was ReturnType<…>, which is a Promise for an async call
entries.fix: Use Awaited<ReturnType<…>> (the current template)

entries.symptom: TS2741: Property 'msUntilNextLocalDay' is missing in type '{ nowMs: …; today: … }' but required in type 'ClockPort'
entries.cause: A hand-written clock object from before ClockPort gained msUntilNextLocalDay (S9 countdown)
entries.fix: In tests use createFakeClock from services/clock/fake-clock.ts (or add msUntilNextLocalDay); code that only reads the time takes Pick<ClockPort, 'nowMs'>

entries.symptom: Cannot find module '@e07/shell/art/game-art.ts'
entries.cause: shell-game-module.ts imports the GameArt types, which no skill shipped before
entries.fix: Copy game-host-integration templates/packages/shell/src/art/game-art.ts and credit-entry.ts (only when missing)

entries.symptom: check-quality-gates fails: a no-restricted-properties message (Date.now) differs from the recorded one
entries.cause: The guardrail compares the restricted-property messages word for word; a reworded ESLint template breaks every npm run verify
entries.fix: Never reword RESTRICTED_PROPERTIES messages; copy eslint.config.mjs from typescript-and-lint-rules byte for byte

entries.symptom: jest --selectProjects unit <file> runs the whole suite instead of the file
entries.cause: Jest reads every word after --selectProjects as another project name
entries.fix: Put the paths first: npx jest <file> --selectProjects unit

entries.symptom: npx jest --selectProjects golden <file> -u rewrote every golden in the project
entries.cause: The path after --selectProjects is read as a project name, so -u applies to all golden tests
entries.fix: Always npx jest <file> --selectProjects golden -u; restore the other goldens from git

entries.symptom: Jest exits 1 with "1 snapshot obsolete" although every test passed
entries.cause: Jest 29.7 fails the run on obsolete snapshot entries, with or without --ci
entries.fix: Remove the obsolete entry with the path-first -u command for that one file, or restore the test that owned it

entries.symptom: jest-haste-map: duplicate manual mock found: expo-iap
entries.cause: Jest indexed skills/, whose fixtures ship __mocks__ with the app's names, and may apply a fixture's mock
entries.fix: Ignore skills, .claude and .stryker-tmp in modulePathIgnorePatterns and testPathIgnorePatterns (the current jest.config.js; check-test-setup jest-ignored-paths)

entries.symptom: Stryker copies about 16,000 files into its sandbox and every mutant run is slow
entries.cause: The sandbox included skills/ and .claude/
entries.fix: Add "skills" and ".claude" to ignorePatterns in stryker.config.json (338 files instead of 16,152)

entries.symptom: A mock expected once is called 2 or 4 times (calls from earlier tests in the file)
entries.cause: The Jest config lacks clearMocks and restoreMocks, so mock calls pile up across tests
entries.fix: Use the canonical jest.config.js (clearMocks: true, restoreMocks: true); never reset by hand in each test

entries.symptom: A component test cannot find the testID of a decorative part (logo art, stars, icon tile)
entries.cause: Toybox components hide decorative parts from VoiceOver, and RNTL skips hidden elements by default
entries.fix: Query decorative parts with { includeHiddenElements: true }; interactive elements stay visible to VoiceOver

entries.symptom: TypeError: AdsConsent.getUserChoices is not a function in a test
entries.cause: An older copy of the AdMob root mock lacks getUserChoices (the consent debug adapter calls it)
entries.fix: Keep one mock: admob-ads' __mocks__/react-native-google-mobile-ads.ts

entries.symptom: renderWithShell fails tsc: type '{ settings; premium }' is missing the following properties from type 'ShellStores': progress, stats
entries.cause: An older render-with-shell.tsx predates the four-store setup
entries.fix: Use unit-and-component-tests' current render-with-shell.tsx
match: missing the following properties from type 'ShellStores'

entries.symptom: A screen test expects "Premium - active" but renders "Premium – active"
entries.cause: The copy deck uses an en dash; the test typed a hyphen
entries.fix: Assert the catalog text exactly; check-catalogs names the first differing code point

entries.symptom: check-tests reports untested-module for a helper that is only tested through its caller (a selector, flip-cells.ts, session-controller.ts)
entries.cause: The rule is "every pure module has its own test"; a caller's test does not count
entries.fix: Write a small direct test next to the module (examples plus a property where it fits); a device-only marker is only for wrappers Jest cannot load

entries.symptom: check-tests reports nondeterminism for performance.now() in a save-write speed test
entries.cause: Only test/**/*.perf.test.ts files may time real work, with performance imported from node:perf_hooks
entries.fix: Move the timing test to test/<area>/<name>.perf.test.ts and import { performance } from 'node:perf_hooks'

entries.symptom: The screenshot matrix waits 15 s and fails on game-start, result-win and similar screens
entries.cause: shoot-screen.yaml waited for ${SCREEN}.screen, but those screens render game.screen and result.screen
entries.fix: Pass the screen's root testID as ROOT to shoot-screen.yaml (current e2e-maestro matrix)

entries.symptom: A Maestro command sent the run off the Mac (test --analyze, cloud, login, record without --local)
entries.cause: Those commands upload screens or results to Maestro's cloud, which the offline policy forbids
entries.fix: Never use them; check-e2e-setup reports them as maestro-upload

entries.symptom: A game balance report stays fresh after game-kit geom/ or timeline code changed
entries.cause: The report fingerprint covered only part of packages/game-kit/src
entries.fix: Use the current game-balance-and-bots writer (the fingerprint covers all of game-kit) and rerun the sim

entries.symptom: A level starts already won or lost
entries.cause: The game's create() returned a finished state
entries.fix: Fix create(); engineContractProblems and check-rules-engine now require every level to start in play

entries.symptom: A real-time sim drops frames or triggers garbage collection with vec2 or sweep in its tick
entries.cause: vec2 and sweep return new objects on every call; a UI-thread tick must allocate nothing
entries.fix: Write the maths with plain numbers inside step functions (geom-kit, "Inside a UI-thread sim"); check-realtime-loop reports it

entries.symptom: Collisions are missed or land in the wrong cell, with no error
entries.cause: rebuildSpatialHash expects two numbers per entity, but a sim body array holds four (x, y, vx, vy)
entries.fix: Pass positions with stride 2, never the raw body array (geom-kit reference)

entries.symptom: The Settings list does not scroll when a drag starts on a volume slider, and the volume jumps
entries.cause: The slider's pan gesture had minDistance(0)
entries.fix: Race pan and tap: the pan starts after 8 pt sideways and fails after 8 pt vertically (current toybox-components Slider); check on a device

entries.symptom: Every screen renders in the system font; Lilita One and Rubik never appear
entries.cause: The expo-font plugin entry embeds only the two Vazirmatn files
entries.fix: One expo-font entry that embeds every Toybox font file; check-design-system reports font-plugin

entries.symptom: tsc rejects t(message) for a game's plain MessageId, and check-i18n-code fails asGameKey(...) outside game-message-text.ts (game-key-cast)
entries.cause: t() only accepts branded Shell keys; the game contract passes plain string ids, and only packages/shell/src/i18n/game-message-text.ts may turn one into a key
entries.fix: Show the text with gameMessageText(t, message) from packages/shell/src/i18n/game-message-text.ts; keep a game's id tables (apps/<id>/src/i18n/keys.ts) as plain 'as const' literals, never asGameKey

entries.symptom: A game message id such as line-siege.lose.board-full has no translation
entries.cause: The id literal in apps/<id>/src is missing from that game's en.json
entries.fix: Add the key to the game's four catalogs (a string the copy deck lacks gets its English text from the owning skill, with fa and ckb marked for native review); check-i18n-code reports every unknown <game-id>.* literal. Lose reasons use one key each: <game-id>.lose.<reason>

entries.symptom: knip reports a game's keys.ts or its exports as unused
entries.cause: keys.ts is an optional table of the game's plain literal ids; knip flags it as soon as no game file imports it
entries.fix: keys.ts is optional: keep only the tables the game imports, or delete it when nothing imports it

entries.symptom: TS2305: direction-context.tsx has no exported member 'DirectionProvider' (or 'DirectionContext')
entries.cause: An older direction-context.tsx; the documented API is DirectionProvider
entries.fix: Copy rtl-and-direction's current direction-context.tsx and import DirectionProvider

entries.symptom: An ADS_MODE=off build contacts Google's consent service at launch (a Google host in the socket report)
entries.cause: Consent was built with createAdmobConsentAdapter directly, ignoring the ads mode
entries.fix: Build it with createConsentPort(adsMode, options); isAdsEnabled is the game's switch AND adsMode !== 'off' (check-ads consent-factory)

entries.symptom: The banner never loads inside the Toybox banner band
entries.cause: The band rendered nothing until the ad was visible, so the native banner never mounted
entries.fix: Never wrap AdBannerSlot; pass the band style as its loadedStyle (useBannerBandStyle), applied only after the ad loads

entries.symptom: The first interstitial or rewarded ad after launch never loads
entries.cause: The ad was preloaded before initialize() had resolved
entries.fix: Await initialize (after consent) before any preload; check-ads behaviour scenarios catch it

entries.symptom: The Premium screen shows a price while the phone is offline
entries.cause: Nothing linked ConnectivityPort to the store flow
entries.fix: Wrap the purchase port with withConnectivity and reload on reconnect (shouldReloadStore); check-premium store-offline

entries.symptom: After Restore the thank-you screen appears instead of "Premium – active"
entries.cause: onRestoreFinished('owned') left didJustPurchase set
entries.fix: Use the current premium-transitions.ts (a restore clears didJustPurchase and sets didJustRestore)

entries.symptom: The debug switch or link premium=1 changes nothing
entries.cause: The Premium reducer had no action for it
entries.fix: Save first, then dispatch debug-premium-set (test builds only; check-premium debug-only)

entries.symptom: const send = globalThis.fetch (or const Socket = WebSocket) passes lint and the bundle audit
entries.cause: The rules matched only direct calls of the network globals
entries.fix: Never alias network globals; audit-repo reports it as network-global

entries.symptom: audit-repo reports private-key for a reference that only mentions "BEGIN PRIVATE KEY"
entries.cause: An older rule matched the words instead of PEM armour
entries.fix: Use the current audit-repo: it reports only -----BEGIN … PRIVATE KEY----- armour, in every file including skills/

entries.symptom: The next move's sounds are dropped after a fast move
entries.cause: Cancelled cues kept their voice slots and repeat windows, and cues scheduled out of order got a negative time gap
entries.fix: Use the current voice policy (voices are intervals on the audio clock; cancelPending releases them)

entries.symptom: Taps, toggles and results make no sound or haptic
entries.cause: Nothing called usePressFeedback or playUiFeedback
entries.fix: Call usePressFeedback() in raised-surface, quiet-button and list-row, playUiFeedback(services, 'win'|'lose') in the result step and 'toggle' in toggles; check-audio-haptics ui-feedback

entries.symptom: No sound on a device build although AUDIO_API_PLUGIN is defined
entries.cause: withShell never adds the audio plugin constant to the plugins list
entries.fix: Add AUDIO_API_PLUGIN to withShell; check-audio-haptics audio-plugin

entries.symptom: A click in the middle of a synthesised sound
entries.cause: A sound layer that starts after 0 has no fade-in
entries.fix: Give every late-starting layer a fade-in of at least 1 ms (the sound-bank quality check)

entries.symptom: The volume slider sits at full and the save holds fractions like 0.8
entries.cause: The Toybox Slider works in 0 to 1; the Settings row passed 0 to 100
entries.fix: Convert percent and fraction at the row and save only when the whole percent changes

entries.symptom: Home and S10 show old stars and statistics until the app restarts
entries.cause: The run end was written with a bare save.update(applyRunEnd …), so the section stores never re-read the document
entries.fix: updateAndPublish(save, stores, { recipe, refreshBackup: true }); check-stores cross-section-write and the game-host check report a bare write

entries.symptom: "Next challenge in {h} h {m} min" is hours off (it counts to UTC midnight)
entries.cause: It was computed in a screen from nowMs() % 86_400_000
entries.fix: Read useNextDayCountdown() (ClockPort.msUntilNextLocalDay(), DST-safe in the system adapter); check-daily-stats reports day-maths-in-ui

entries.symptom: E2E or parity cannot find daily.week-day.7 or stats.week-bar.7 for today
entries.cause: The strip was numbered by ISO weekday instead of position
entries.fix: Number by position (1 = six days ago, 7 = today); the weekday only picks the letter and name

entries.symptom: Two daily-view (or stats-view) files in one folder; imports pick the wrong one
entries.cause: The pure summary was named daily-view.ts next to the DailyView component daily-view.tsx
entries.fix: The pure summaries are daily-summary.ts and stats-summary.ts (useDailySummary, useStatsSummary)

entries.symptom: Two games' daily levels follow the same seed sequence
entries.cause: A game copied the template's daily salt 0x5446
entries.fix: Use the FNV-1a salt the scaffold prints for the game id; check-levels reports daily-salt-shared

entries.symptom: Continue is offered in a game whose config disables it
entries.cause: The composition root hard-coded isContinueAllowed: true
entries.fix: Read it from the game config; check-host reports continue-from-config

entries.symptom: App crashes at boot with "file is not a database"
entries.cause: save.db itself is not an SQLite file (never seen with WAL and synchronous = FULL)
entries.fix: Not handled yet: moving save.db aside and starting fresh needs a file API and the owner's approval; send the owner the error and the file size

entries.symptom: A correct tall screen (S10, S11, S15) fails parity at every scroll offset except 0
entries.cause: The fixed top bar covers scrolled content, and the banner is pinned to the screen bottom while the design draws it at the end of the page
entries.fix: Use the current toybox-visual-parity (frame geometry and scroll plan); run-parity chooses the offsets

entries.symptom: Every scroll offset passes, all showing the top of the screen
entries.cause: The parity harness ignored the requested scrollY
entries.fix: Apply scrollY in the harness; check-parity reports scroll-mismatch beyond 2 pt

entries.symptom: Parity fails on *.banner-ad in an ADS_MODE=off capture
entries.cause: Off mode draws no banner and the slot has zero height until an ad loads
entries.fix: The harness supplies a stand-in 320 x 50 banner that reports itself loaded, inside the band style

entries.symptom: A whole-screen parity run is cut off by the 2-minute command timeout
entries.cause: One run takes 10 to 20 s, and a screen such as S12 has 36 runs
entries.fix: Run it in the background or frame by frame

entries.symptom: capture-app cannot find the app by a .test bundle id
entries.cause: Test and store builds share one bundle id; com.example.<game> is the placeholder until the owner approves one
entries.fix: Read the id from the built app with plutil (CFBundleIdentifier)

entries.symptom: The commit-msg hook fails with spawnSync git ENOBUFS
entries.cause: check-commit-message.ts read the staged diff with the default 1 MB buffer; staging skills/ exceeds it
entries.fix: Use the current check-commit-message.ts (raised maxBuffer)

entries.symptom: The first commit swept in the owner's uncommitted handbook edits, the design folder and skills/
entries.cause: The bootstrap staged with git add -A
entries.fix: Stage only the generated files and ask the owner about the rest

entries.symptom: A commit that touches only skills/ is rejected for a missing Gate-Change trailer
entries.cause: An older commit-msg hook (or check-commits.mjs) matched gated-path globs such as **/tsconfig.json, **/__image_snapshots__/**, **/fixtures/save-v*.json and **/*.snap.ios against skill templates and fixtures
entries.fix: Update packages/tooling/src/git/commit-message-rules.ts from the monorepo-bootstrap or quality-gates templates: isGatedFile matches whole repo paths and lets a file under skills/ or .claude/ count only for a pattern that starts with that folder (.claude/settings.json stays gated); git-commits-and-reporting's check-commits.mjs applies the same rule

entries.symptom: check-test-edits reports code-without-test for a fix to a device-only wrapper (the expo-sqlite driver)
entries.cause: The rule ignored the device-only marker; with --log it can only see the marker when the diff shows the first lines
entries.fix: Keep "// device-only: covered by <check>" in the first 6 lines and check with --range or --staged (current tdd-workflow)

entries.symptom: Reduce Motion is on but buttons still sink and spring
entries.cause: No root MotionConfig applies the reduce-motion setting to Reanimated's layout and spring animations
entries.fix: Wrap the app root in the MotionConfig from toybox-design-system's motion reference, fed by useReduceMotion

entries.symptom: VoiceOver swipe up or down does nothing on a slider
entries.cause: accessibilityRole 'adjustable' without accessibilityActions increment and decrement
entries.fix: Add both actions and onAccessibilityAction; check-a11y-code requires them

entries.symptom: check-perf-report fails on cold starts recorded by an older build
entries.cause: The perf log survives app updates, so earlier builds were mixed in
entries.fix: Use the current checker (judges the latest 5 cold starts; the simulator baseline drops the first of the latest 6)

entries.symptom: Animations run at 60 Hz on a ProMotion iPhone
entries.cause: Info.plist lacks CADisableMinimumFrameDurationOnPhone = true
entries.fix: withShell sets it; check-perf-code reports promotion-plist

entries.symptom: The first npm run -s check:fast or lint crashes: ConfigError: Config "UserConfig[0][4] > typescript-eslint/base": Key "plugins": Cannot redefine plugin "@typescript-eslint".
entries.cause: Two copies of @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin: a fresh install resolved eslint-config-expo's caret range (^8.59.0) to a newer release (8.71.0, one day old) while typescript-eslint 8.70.1 nested its own 8.70.1, and both register the plugin name
entries.fix: Root overrides pin all ten @typescript-eslint/* packages (eslint-plugin, parser, project-service, scope-manager, tsconfig-utils, type-utils, types, typescript-estree, utils, visitor-keys) at the typescript-eslint pin 8.70.1; npm install; npm ls @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin shows one version. check-deps-policy fails while the lockfile holds two versions of a versions-table package

entries.symptom: tsc -p apps/<id> fails with TS2769 "No overload matches this call": Argument of type '"Settings"' is not assignable to parameter of type 'never' at every navigation.navigate(...) in Shell hooks, while tsc -p packages/shell passes
entries.cause: The app program type-checks the Shell files it imports but never sees packages/shell/src/navigation/react-navigation.d.ts: nothing imports a global augmentation, so RootParamList is empty there
entries.fix: Add the Shell's packages/shell/src/navigation/react-navigation.d.ts to the include list of apps/<id>/tsconfig.json (as a path relative to the app folder, next to the app-env.d.ts entry); typescript-and-lint-rules' tsconfig.app.json has it and check-configs requires it

entries.symptom: knip reports "Unused devDependencies: @formatjs/cli package.json"
entries.cause: packages/tooling/src/i18n/verify-catalogs.ts runs the formatjs verify command through npx; knip sees no import of the package
entries.fix: Keep the devDependency; the knip.json template lists @formatjs/cli in the root ignoreDependencies (copy knip.json from quality-gates' templates, the reason is in its root-files reference)

entries.symptom: knip reports "Unlisted dependencies: expo-iap/build/types.js __mocks__/expo-iap.ts" and "react-native-audio-api __mocks__/react-native-audio-api.ts"
entries.cause: The root __mocks__ (unit-and-component-tests, game-audio-and-haptics) import the real libraries' types and helpers; the apps install those libraries, the root does not
entries.fix: Never add them as root dependencies: the knip.json template lists expo-iap and react-native-audio-api in the root ignoreDependencies, next to Skia, Gesture Handler, Reanimated and Worklets (copy knip.json from quality-gates' templates)

entries.symptom: knip reports "Unlisted binaries" pgrep, plutil, sqlite3 and footprint in packages/tooling/src/{audit,build,e2e}/*.ts
entries.cause: The tooling templates start macOS system tools by name (simulator helper, build script, runtime network audit, privacy manifest audit, simulator perf steps); they are not npm packages and can never be listed
entries.fix: The knip.json template has the top-level "ignoreBinaries": ["footprint", "pgrep", "plutil", "sqlite3"] (copy it from quality-gates' templates). Any other unlisted binary is a real finding: install the tool as a devDependency or stop calling it; a new ignore entry needs the owner and a Gate-Change: trailer (check-gate-wiring rule knip-ignores)

entries.symptom: knip reports "Unused exports" in packages/shell/src/app/test-only-entry.ts (createDebugServices, TEST_BUILD_SENTINEL, readParityRequest ...) or in packages/shell/src/app/parity/
entries.cause: Those exports are reached only through the require() in app/test-only.ts, which knip does not follow; includeEntryExports is on for the Shell, so adding the file as an entry does not help
entries.fix: Tag each export that only the test build reaches with /** @public */, which knip honours (ios-simulator-build's test-only-entry.ts template does; tag the parity harness exports it re-exports the same way); never add the file to knip's ignore

entries.symptom: knip reports "Unused exports" that only a screen not built yet uses (useIsTestBuild, useStatsSummary, selectLevels, selectCanShowUpsell, DialogKind, EMPTY_FX)
entries.cause: A partial Shell: the templates of a layer land before the screens that read them
entries.fix: Declare the slice in shell-slice.json ({ "screens": [...], "why": "..." }); npm run verify then runs knip without its export and type kinds and prints SKIP shell-slice.json [knip-exports]. Build the screen or delete the export before the file is deleted; never tag such an export @public

entries.symptom: npm run audit:network crashes with ENOENT ... apps/<id>/node_modules/react-native (or later on a dangling CocoaPods header symlink under node_modules/@e07/<id>/ios/Pods)
entries.cause: network-native-layer.ts looked for react-native under the app's own node_modules, but npm workspaces hoist it to the root; its package-root guess for a podspec at a package's root also turned into the whole node_modules folder and walked through the workspace symlink into Pods
entries.fix: Use the current privacy-and-network-audit template: it resolves each module with createRequire from the app's package.json, walks up to each module's own package.json, and skips symlinks in the file walk

entries.symptom: verify turns red with no change in the repo: expo install --check prints "expo@57.0.25 - expected version: ~57.0.26" or expo-doctor fails "Patch version mismatches"
entries.cause: Expo published a patch release less than 7 days ago; the fix the tools print (install it) is refused by the release-age rule (min-release-age=7)
entries.fix: Use the current check-deps.ts (dependency-management): it reads the publish time with npm view <pkg> time and prints "WARN ... min-release-age=7 refuses it until <due date>" instead of failing. On the due date run npx expo install <pkg>@~<version> in every app and move its versions-table row and any root override in the same commit; from that date the mismatch fails. Never add an exclude block or skip the step

entries.symptom: A tall screen captured at a deep scroll offset stops short (S11 asked for y1170 and y1200, both stuck at 1104.7): scroll-mismatch
entries.cause: The ScrollView's first layout happens before the safe-area insets arrive, so its frame is too tall and iOS clamps the offset to a smaller maximum; when the insets arrive the frame shrinks but the content size does not change, so a scroll made only in onContentSizeChange never runs again
entries.fix: Apply ScreenBody's scrollToY from both onContentSizeChange and onLayout (the current toybox-screens ScreenBody template does)

entries.symptom: npm run verify stops at test:sim: "No tests found, exiting with code 1"
entries.cause: No game has a *.sim.test.ts yet: before the pilot's sims (Shell build step 3) test:sim has nothing to run
entries.fix: Expected before that step (quality-gates, "When verify is green"). While shell-slice.json exists, verify skips the step with SKIP jest.sim.config.js [test-sim]; otherwise build the pilot's sims. Never add --passWithNoTests
match: No tests found, exiting with code 1

entries.symptom: npm run test:coverage fails on a repo built from the templates: Jest: "global" coverage threshold for statements (90%) not met: 83.8%
entries.cause: Template files that ship neither a test nor the device-only marker count at 0% (native adapters, Skia and frame-callback modules, composition files, model hooks)
entries.fix: Give each file a test (fakes, pure helpers, model hooks through renderWithShell) or, for native, Skia, frame-callback and composition files only, the line "// device-only: covered by <e2e flow or simulator check>" in its first 6 lines; jest.config.js leaves exactly the marked files out through packages/tooling/src/quality/device-only.ts. Never lower a threshold or hand-write coveragePathIgnorePatterns

entries.symptom: A subset run such as npx jest apps/<id>/src/rules --ci --coverage --selectProjects unit exits 1: Jest: "global" coverage threshold for statements (90%) not met: 0% (or 6.18%), although every test passed
entries.cause: The root config's thresholds count every file collectCoverageFrom names, and the subset ran only a few of them
entries.fix: Only npm run test:coverage judges the thresholds. For a subset: npx jest <paths> --ci --selectProjects unit --coverage --collectCoverageFrom='<path>/**/*.ts' --coverageThreshold='{}' (paths first)

entries.symptom: check-test-setup fails render-with-shell-missing although the only component test says // no-shell-context: in its header
entries.cause: An older check-test-setup counted tests that need no Shell providers
entries.fix: Use the current unit-and-component-tests: tests marked // no-shell-context: <why> are not counted; the helper is required once a component test needs the Shell

entries.symptom: check-commits fails spec-ref-missing ("the body names no spec line") on commits the commit-msg hook accepted
entries.cause: An older commit-msg hook used a weaker rule set than check-commits.mjs
entries.fix: Copy commit-message-rules.ts, commit-trailer-rules.ts, commit-message-samples.json and the test from quality-gates' templates: the hook now enforces the same rules with the same ids. Name the spec lines in every feat or fix body; report commits already made instead of rewriting shared history

entries.symptom: check-gate-wiring fails script-target-missing for packages/tooling/src/i18n/verify-catalogs.ts and packages/tooling/src/audit/audit-network.ts on a fresh skeleton
entries.cause: Later skills build those two gate scripts (i18n-strings-and-catalogs, privacy-and-network-audit)
entries.fix: Run build step 1's command in full: check-gate-wiring.mjs . --pending packages/tooling/src/i18n/verify-catalogs.ts --pending packages/tooling/src/audit/audit-network.ts; drop each flag once its file exists

entries.symptom: A skill checker prints ERROR [bad-input] Unknown option '--root'
entries.cause: Every checker takes the repo root as its first positional argument, never --root
entries.fix: Run node <skill scripts folder>/<checker>.mjs . [options], exactly as the build order and the SKILL.md write it; the error's Fix text prints the positional form

entries.symptom: A checker exits 2 with ERROR [bad-input] nothing to check (no flows yet, a turn-based repo, a folder that does not exist)
entries.cause: Exit 2 means bad input or nothing to check; it is never a pass. A checker that can prove from a repo fact that it does not apply prints NOT APPLICABLE: <fact> and RESULT: PASS instead, and rules out of reach in a partial Shell print SKIP lines
entries.fix: Rerun with the full command from the build order; if the target is built by a later step, name the check as not run yet in the report. Count only RESULT: PASS (with SKIP lines or NOT APPLICABLE) as a pass

entries.symptom: A repo checker reports findings inside skills/ (check-golden-changes: 396 fixture PNGs without Gate-Change; check-test-edits: it.skip and retryTimes lines; check-premium: get-task-allow in templates)
entries.cause: The checker walked or diffed the whole repo, including the in-repo skill library, whose fixtures plant these findings on purpose
entries.fix: Use the current skills: every repo-scanning checker skips REPO_SCAN_IGNORES (skills/, .claude/, node_modules, Pods, generated native and build output). A checker that still reports skills/ paths is a library bug: fix it with skill-maintenance (walk with REPO_SCAN_IGNORES, filter git paths with isRepoScanIgnored, add a fixture with a planted skills/ folder)

entries.symptom: npx expo-doctor prints "Found duplicates for react-native-screens" (or another native module), or check-sdk-alignment fails duplicate-native / check-deps-policy fails peer-override
entries.cause: The Shell declares the native module as a "*" peer, so npm put its newest release at the root next to the version the apps install (for example react-native-screens 4.28.0 beside 4.26.2)
entries.fix: Add a root override pinned at the version the apps install (npm ls <pkg> shows it; dependency-management's plan-dependency prints it), npm install, then npm ls <pkg> shows one copy

entries.symptom: npm run audit:network crashes with ENOENT: no such file or directory, scandir '<repo>/apps/<game>/node_modules/react-native' (or a scandir under node_modules/@e07/<game>/ios/Pods) in network-native-layer.ts
entries.cause: An old copy of the network audit template looked for react-native inside the app folder; npm hoists it to the root, and the old walk followed workspace symlinks
entries.fix: Copy packages/tooling/src/audit/network-native-layer.ts and its test again from privacy-and-network-audit (it resolves react-native from the app's package.json and skips symlinks), then rerun audit:network

entries.symptom: npm run build:ios:sim stops with 'preflight failed, nothing was built: "audit:privacy" runs packages/tooling/src/audit/audit-privacy.ts, which does not exist' (older copies failed after the prebuild with Cannot find module ... audit-privacy.ts)
entries.cause: The simulator build runs audit:privacy right after every prebuild, and the privacy and network audit tooling is not in the repo yet
entries.fix: Copy privacy-and-network-audit's tooling (packages/tooling/src/audit/, packages/tooling/network-audit/) and its npm scripts before the first simulator build, then build again

entries.symptom: check-flows fails [flows-missing]: the repo has no Maestro flows
entries.cause: A full Shell (no shell-slice.json) must have its E2E flows; only a declared partial Shell skips the rule
entries.fix: Write the flows with e2e-maestro (numbered flows under packages/shell/e2e/flows/ and each game's own), or declare the partial Shell in shell-slice.json while it is one

entries.symptom: check-release-setup or check-store-artifact fails [shell-complete]: shell-slice.json exists, a route still uses NotBuiltScreen, or the bundle contains not-built.screen
entries.cause: A partial Shell never ships: the release gates refuse a repo that still declares a slice or routes a screen to the NotBuiltScreen stand-in
entries.fix: Build the missing screens (toybox-screens), route every screen to its real component, delete shell-slice.json, then rerun the gate

entries.symptom: npm run build:ios:sim fails with ** BUILD FAILED ** in a pod (Google-Mobile-Ads-SDK, openiap): a precompiled .pcm under apps/<game>/build/dd/ModuleCache.noindex "was compiled with module cache path" of another folder, then "missing required module 'SwiftShims'"
entries.cause: The repo was copied or moved: the build script cleans ios/ but keeps apps/<game>/build/dd, and that DerivedData module cache still names the old repo path
entries.fix: Delete apps/<game>/build/dd (rm -rf apps/<game>/build/dd), then rerun the same build; after copying or moving a repo, delete build/dd and ios/ of each app before its first simulator build
match: was compiled with module cache path

entries.symptom: simctl boot (npm run e2e:ios, build:ios:sim or setup-parity-sim) exits with "Unable to boot device due to insufficient system resources" and maxUserProcs / runningUserProcs numbers
entries.cause: Too many simulators are booted on this Mac, other sessions' included, so the per-user process limit is reached
entries.fix: Shut down only this session's own e07-* simulators that are not needed now (xcrun simctl shutdown <its name or udid>), then rerun the command; never shutdown all, never touch another session's simulator, never erase
match: Unable to boot device due to insufficient system resources

entries.symptom: A debug link is ignored after launchApp clearState: the flow's first openLink (debug-setup) applies no language, save or screen and the error log stays empty, while the same link a few seconds later works; or firstRun=0&screen=game in one link lands on Home instead of Game
entries.cause: The app was launched without the URL and its JS had not started the link handler yet, so neither getInitialURL nor the url event delivered the link; a screen= opened before the Main group mounted is lost as well
entries.fix: Use e2e-maestro's link timing: the debug link handler starts listening when createDebugParts runs and queues links until the navigator is ready, applies the save changes first and opens screen= on the next navigation state; debug-setup.yaml waits for the app's first screen root (language-choice.screen, tutorial.screen, home.screen or not-built.screen) before openLink. Never add a fixed sleep

entries.symptom: npm run e2e:ios fails the memory step: "memory: the app is not running after the smoke flow", so check-e2e-report fails memory
entries.cause: Maestro 2.10 stops the app when a test ends, so no app process is left for footprint to measure
entries.fix: Use e2e-maestro's sim-perf-steps template: after the smoke flows it relaunches the app with xcrun simctl launch (the app resumes its saved state), waits for its pid and 10 s more, then runs footprint; its test covers the relaunch
match: memory: the app is not running after the smoke flow

entries.symptom: run-parity prints CAPTURE FAILED (unstable), or capture-app fails [unstable]: the screen never held still for 300 ms (for example S8 with the current level tile's flag bobbing)
entries.cause: A decorative loop keeps running in the parity launch: a component repeats an animation (withRepeat) without honouring useReduceMotion, so the frozen-motion switch of a parity launch (animations=off, isParityMotionFrozen) cannot hold it at rest
entries.fix: Make the loop read useReduceMotion() and rest when it is true: the shared app/use-reduce-motion.ts returns true while TEST_ONLY?.isParityMotionFrozen() is true, which freezes flag bobs, busy blocks, sticker slaps, star pops and confetti without touching the saved Reduce motion setting; never waive it and never raise --settle-ms for it

entries.symptom: check-parity fails [structure] with 1-2 pt blobs at the corners of dashed edges: the locked level tiles and the locked pack panel on Levels (S8), the continue-offer box on Result (S7); a dashed-edge structure difference that no style change removes
entries.cause: React Native on iOS draws borderStyle dashed with its own dash length and phase, and no style sets them, so the dashes never line up with Chrome's
entries.fix: Copy the pre-listed platform waiver for that element (class platform, rule structure, the cause above) from toybox-visual-parity's templates/parity/waivers.json into parity/waivers.json (check-parity's fix text names the entry), in a commit with a Gate-Change: trailer, and name the waivers in the owner report; never redraw the edge in Skia and never widen the tolerance. A structure failure on a solid edge is a real difference

entries.symptom: Only one interstitial ever shows: after the first one no interstitial is ever due again, and ads.history.levelsCompletedSinceInterstitial stays 0
entries.cause: The run end never records a finished level in the ad history: createGameHost gets no extendRunEnd that calls recordLevelEnd, so the policy's minLevelsCompletedBetween is never reached
entries.fix: Pass extendRunEnd: recordAdLevelEnd to createGameHost in create-shell-parts.ts (level runs only, in the same run-end save), with the test that a won level counts in the ad history (game-host-integration and admob-ads templates)

entries.symptom: check-balance fails [report-stale] although the rules and tuning did not change
entries.cause: The balance report's fingerprint covers the game's logic folders, the sim file and the game-kit files those import (followed through game-kit's own imports); one of them changed, or reports/ is gitignored and the local report was made before the change
entries.fix: Rerun npm run test:sim, then check-balance.mjs . --game <id>; never edit the report by hand. New game-kit files the sims do not import (timeline, particles, geometry) leave the report fresh

entries.symptom: S11 Settings (or S6 Pause) parity fails [missing] on settings.music-switch, settings.music-volume-row or pause.music, with many [bounds] and scroll-mismatch failures below, for a game without music (Line Siege)
entries.cause: The capture was compared with the base reference, which draws the Music rows, while the app correctly hides them when the game's sound bank has no music
entries.fix: Captures pick the reference variant from parity/game-facts.json (hasMusic false selects s11-settings--no-music and s6-pause--no-music); write or correct that file for the app (its parity-game-facts test pins it to the game module), commit it with a Gate-Change: trailer, and rerun; never force hasMusic in the app and never waive missing rows

entries.symptom: S7 Result win parity fails [text] on result.score-card.moves-line ("7 moves – par 7" in the design) for a score-rated game such as Line Siege
entries.cause: The base reference shows the moves-against-par line, while a score-rated win shows the score line (result.win.score-line with score and best), because par is null
entries.fix: Set winLine score for the app in parity/game-facts.json so captures use s7-result-win--score (gated path: Gate-Change: trailer); the app keeps result.win.score-line, and moves-rated games keep result.win.moves

entries.symptom: Levels (S8) in fa or ckb fails [text-ink] on every level number (ink height 10.0 vs design 14.0): the tops of the Persian digits are cut off on the device
entries.cause: A line height of 1.0 clips Vazirmatn's tall digits on iOS, while Chrome lets them overflow the line box
entries.fix: The levelNumber role's Persian line height is 1.45 in the tokens (and the references were re-rendered with it); copy the current type roles from toybox-design-system and rerun; never waive clipped digits

entries.symptom: maestro check-syntax (check-flows --syntax) prints "Parsing Failed at <line>:<col>" on an evalScript line that holds a ternary (cond ? a : b)
entries.cause: A ": " inside a plain YAML scalar starts a mapping, so the flow file is not valid YAML
entries.fix: Write the choice as arithmetic (Number(cond)) or quote the whole scalar; never put ": " in an unquoted evalScript

entries.symptom: check-balance fails [harness-outdated] (or [report-stale] right after upgrading the skills)
entries.cause: packages/tooling/src/sims/write-sim-report.ts is an older copy that hashes all of packages/game-kit/src, not only the game-kit files the sims import
entries.fix: Copy game-balance-and-bots' packages/tooling/src/sims/write-sim-report.ts and its test write-sim-report.test.ts again, then rerun npm run test:sim and check-balance.mjs . --game <id>

entries.symptom: tsc and eslint fail with TS2307 "Cannot find module 'fast-check'" on the game-kit tests right after copying the kit (or check-rules-engine fails [kit-test-dependency])
entries.cause: The kit's property tests import fast-check, which the bootstrap leaves out
entries.fix: Run npm install -D -E fast-check@4.10.2 at the repo root, then npm approve-scripts --allow-scripts-pending and approve fsevents if it is listed (Shell step 2 of game-rules-engine and level-generation-and-solvers)

entries.symptom: check-deps-policy fails expo-spec or table-version: expo-constants is "~57.0.20" after npx expo install, while the versions table says ~57.0.19
entries.cause: A bare npx expo install takes a same-day patch from Expo's online versions list
entries.fix: Install with the table spec: (cd apps/<id> && npx expo install <pkg>@<table spec>) (plan-dependency.mjs prints it); the newer patch stays a WARN with its due date until it is 7 days old

entries.symptom: Google's consent form opens at launch (or over a level) without the S3 intro, or check-ads fails [consent-moment] with "prepareAds() is called outside the consent moment"
entries.cause: prepareAds runs somewhere other than admob-ads' consent moment, so the S3 intro step is skipped
entries.fix: Copy admob-ads' consent moment (app/consent-moment.tsx, consent-moment-context.tsx, use-consent-moment.ts and services/ads/consent-moment-flow.ts), mount <ConsentMoment> around the navigator in ShellFeatures, and let screens only ask for the ad moment through useBannerSlot; rerun check-ads.mjs .
match: prepareAds\(\) is called outside the consent moment

entries.symptom: No ad ever loads in a test build with test ads (no banner, the rewarded offer stays hidden), or check-ads fails [consent-moment] with "nothing prepares ads"
entries.cause: Nothing runs the ad gate's prepareAds: the consent moment is not mounted, or no banner screen asks it for the ad moment, so the SDK is never initialised
entries.fix: Mount admob-ads' <ConsentMoment> in ShellFeatures with consent-moment-flow.ts, and use useBannerSlot on Home, Levels and Statistics (it calls requestAdMoment); rerun check-ads.mjs .

entries.symptom: S6 Pause parity (and the S5 top bar under it) fails [missing] on game.hint-button for a game without solver hints (Line Siege)
entries.cause: The design's game top bar always draws a hint key, while the app leaves the key out for a game whose hints are none (a hidden key, never a broken one); no game fact selects a reference without it yet
entries.fix: Owner decision (asked 2026-09-30): a hasHints game fact with a --no-hints reference variant, like hasMusic. Until it is decided, leave the S6 sign-off of a hint-less game open; never waive the missing key and never draw a dead hint key

entries.symptom: S7 Result win in fa or ckb fails [text-ink] on result.score-card.value (ink height about 29 vs 38 pt): the tops of the Persian digits of the 44 pt score are cut off
entries.cause: The scoreValue type role keeps a Persian line height of 1.0, which clips Vazirmatn's tall digits on iOS (the same clip the level numbers had before they moved to 1.45)
entries.fix: Owner decision (asked 2026-09-30): the token scoreValue.arabicLineHeight 1.45 with a matching mockup rule and a re-render, as for levelNumber. Until then the fa and ckb S7 win sign-offs stay open; never waive clipped digits

entries.symptom: The Shell journey 02-core-journey-offline fails "Assertion is false: id: daily.screen is visible" after tapping home.daily-card: nothing on Home opens S9 Daily challenge
entries.cause: navigation-and-routing's table says the daily card title opens S9 (navigate('Daily')), but the Toybox design draws the daily panel flat, with only the Play today's challenge button (the testID map's note asks which element opens S9), so the Home view has no control for it and a player cannot reach S9
entries.fix: Owner decision (found on the simulator 2026-09-30): which Home element opens S9 and how VoiceOver reaches it. Until then S9 is reachable only through the debug link (screen=daily); do not make the whole card pressable (VoiceOver would lose the play button inside it)
